data.jd_text:
**General Description** 




 Join a leading project delivery and consulting environment supporting large\-scale asset management and capital project initiatives across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. We are looking for experienced Asset Management Project Managers with strong expertise in asset lifecycle management, governance, and delivery within asset\-intensive industries.
 



  





 This opportunity is ideal for senior project management professionals who can operate at the intersection of capital project delivery and long\-term asset performance, ensuring assets are properly governed, documented, commissioned, and transitioned into operations.
 



  





 The role requires strong stakeholder management, structured project governance, and deep understanding of asset management frameworks such as ISO 55000 within complex enterprise or infrastructure environments.
 



  





 This is a contract / freelance engagement (initial 6 months) supporting ongoing regional transformation and infrastructure programs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of asset management projects from initiation through commissioning and operational handover
* Manage project scope, schedule, cost, risks, issues, and stakeholder alignment across the full delivery lifecycle
* Develop and maintain asset registers, asset data standards, and governance frameworks for asset information management
* Implement asset lifecycle and maintenance strategies aligned with ISO 55000 and recognized asset management practices
* Coordinate closely with engineering, operations, maintenance, and client stakeholders to ensure delivery and operational objectives remain aligned
* Drive governance activities including status reporting, steering committee updates, change management, and escalation management
* Oversee commissioning and handover processes, ensuring complete documentation, asset readiness, and clear operational ownership
* Track project benefits, delivery performance, and operational outcomes against agreed objectives and KPIs
* Apply structured PMO and project delivery methodologies consistently throughout the engagement



  





**Required Experience** 



* Minimum 15\+ years of project management experience within asset\-intensive industries such as infrastructure, utilities, energy, transportation, industrial, or large\-scale facilities environments
* Strong experience delivering asset management or capital project initiatives within the UAE, Saudi Arabia, or wider GCC region
* Hands\-on knowledge of asset management standards and frameworks, particularly ISO 55000
* Proven experience managing project governance, risk management, stakeholder communication, and operational handover activities
* Experience building and managing asset registers, maintenance strategies, and lifecycle management processes
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage senior client leadership and PMO stakeholders
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification is highly preferred
* IAM or other asset management certifications are considered an advantage
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, or related discipline
* Arabic language skills are advantageous but not mandatory
* Immediate or short\-notice availability is highly preferred



  





**Work Setup** 




 • Contract / Freelance engagement
 



 • Initial 6\-month contract
 



 • Onsite

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 With offices in 152 countries and nearly 328,000 professionals, we are one of the world’s leading professional services networks, helping organizations and individuals create lasting value through Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. For over 40 years, we have contributed to the Middle East’s transformation journey, partnering with governments and businesses to deliver sustainable solutions. Today, more than 12,000 of us across Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are shaping the region’s future.
   

  

**Line Of Service Overview**
 Our Deals Line of Service helps clients navigate complex transactions, from strategy through execution. We deliver insights and solutions that create value across the deal lifecycle, supporting organizations in achieving sustainable growth and transformation.
   

  

**Business Unit Overview**
 The Delivering Deal Value (DDV) team within Deals Strategy \& Operations provides strategic and operational advice to investors, governments, and major corporations. We focus on operational integration, carve\-outs, and value creation to help clients realize synergies and achieve their strategic objectives.
   

  

**How You’ll Contribute**
 As a Deals Delivering Value Director focused on the Technology, Media and Telecommunications (TMT) sector, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
   

  

* Overseeing post\-merger integrations, identifying and leveraging synergies to enhance value creation and ensure successful integration of acquisitions for clients in the TMT sectors
* Providing expert advice on setting deal strategies, managing post\-deal execution, and supporting operational due diligence for potential acquisitions
* Assisting government entities and other clients with Day 1 readiness activities to ensure smooth transitions and operational continuity post\-acquisition
* Managing complex projects, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery while leading and coaching teams of consultants
* Cultivating and managing relationships with key stakeholders, including government officials, industry leaders, and senior executives
* Leading business development efforts, including drafting proposals and marketing materials to secure new mandates
* Identifying and pursuing opportunities to sell additional services and collaborating with the DDV team and the wider PwC network
* Mentoring and developing junior team members, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance work environment


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience leading value creation initiatives across the deal lifecycle (pre\-deal, carve\-out, post\-acquisition, and exit) for TMT assets
* Digital infrastructure and AI experience (data centers, fibre, towers, cloud platforms) is a must\-have for this role
* Developed and executed 100\-day plans and full value creation roadmaps aligned to investment theses and shareholder objective
* Identify and deliver enhancement opportunities, including revenue growth, cost optimization, and operational efficiency
* Lead synergy assessment and integration planning for buy\-and\-build strategies within the TMT ecosystem
* Proven experience working within the Middle East region, with a strong understanding of regional market dynamics
* Expertise in executing and program managing post\-merger integrations and carve\-outs across large and small transactions
* Strong track record in delivering transaction\-related services such as operational due diligence, post\-merger integration, carve\-outs, and operational turnarounds
* Deep understanding of investment strategies, deal structuring, and the M\&A process, with the ability to provide actionable insights and solutions
* Excellent leadership and team management skills, with experience guiding projects from inception to completion
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build credibility with senior stakeholders
* Arabic language proficiency is required
* Your flexibility to trav el 30\-40% of the time. This means we may require you to work away from your base office location on a regular basis, and frequent overnight stays may be required. Where possible, we will take your preferences into account and strike a balance between meeting your career development/personal needs and those of the business and our clients


**How You’ll Make a Difference**
 At PwC Middle East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level.
   

  

**Why You’ll Love Working at PwC**
 At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job – you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well\-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Are you ready to make a difference? Want to unlock new value by applying your unique perspective and talents? You can grow exponentially here. Discover more about Life at PwC Middle East .

**Company Description** 




 NEXUS AIDC Inc (NEXUS) has developed the world’s first AI\-native Data Center Operating System to meet the ever\-growing demands of AI workloads and complex infrastructure. By unifying DCIM, APM, FinOps, Kubernetes orchestration, AI workload management, and full\-stack observability, NEXUS offers a single intelligent system for seamless data center operation. This innovative platform drives automated remediation, predictive intelligence, and optimized performance to eliminate silos and deliver complete real\-time visibility.
 



  





**We are now expanding aggressively across the MEA and APAC regions and are looking for a senior leader to help scale regional delivery and deployment execution for the platform.** 




  





**Role Description** 




 This is a high\-impact leadership position at the intersection of AI infrastructure, enterprise transformation, and large\-scale platform execution. This is a full\-time role for the MEA \& APAC regions, based in Dubai with a hybrid work arrangement.
 



  





 The individual stepping into this role will lead the regional deployment lifecycle of a category\-defining AI infrastructure platform across complex enterprise and hyperscale environments. You will work directly across engineering, enterprise customers, strategic partners, and regional delivery ecosystems to ensure scalable, resilient, and high\-performance deployments across MEA and APAC.
 



  





 Responsibilities include program planning, stakeholder engagement, resource allocation, overseeing project milestones, and ensuring high\-quality delivery across MEA \& APAC regions. The role also includes providing strategic guidance, mentoring team members, and fostering a culture of collaboration and performance excellence.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* 15\+ years of progressive leadership in technical delivery, professional services, or complex enterprise deployments within SaaS, Hyper\-Scale Cloud, or AI Infrastructure.
* Combination of elite operational execution and deep technical literacy. You must have the weight to interface with enterprise C\-suites and the depth to speak the same language as infrastructure engineers.
* Proven experience successfully scaling enterprise software or deep\-tech platforms across MEA (including KSA) and APAC, with an intricate understanding of regional compliance and sovereign data dynamics.
* An entrepreneurial, high\-agency operator who thrives in high\-velocity environments and can bring structure to rapid, exponential growth.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a highly quantitative field.
* Strong Program Management and Project Management abilities, with expertise in coordinating large\-scale initiatives across multiple regions.
* Experience in Consulting to engage stakeholders and provide strategic advice in alignment with business goals.
* Exceptional problem\-solving, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to navigate cross\-cultural environments effectively.
* Advanced degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Ability to manage hybrid work environments and work collaboratively across global time zones.



  





**What's in it for you?** 



* You won't just be watching the AI boom; you will be delivering the fundamental software layer making it sustainable.
* You will work alongside brilliant, high\-IQ pioneers who value clarity of thought, intellectual honesty, and relentless execution.
* The freedom to build, scale, and optimize regional delivery structures without legacy corporate red tape.
* Competitive salary, performance incentives, and equity in a category\-defining company.



  





***NOTE:***
*This role is purely focused on software control layers, compute infrastructure orchestration, deployment execution, and AI infrastructure operations. Traditional Building Management Systems (BMS) or FMS experience is not relevant to this position.*

data.jd_text:
**Job Overview
 
 :** 




 The Projects Director is responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, and successful delivery of all projects within the organization. The role oversees the full project lifecycle from pre\-construction through execution and handover, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The Projects Director operates as the senior authority across all project teams, aligning engineering, procurement, commercial, and site operations with the company’s business objectives and premium construction standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities
 
 :** 




 Strategic Leadership \& Portfolio Management
 


* Lead and oversee the entire project portfolio from inception to final handover.
* Define project governance structures, reporting frameworks, and performance benchmarks.
* Align project execution strategy with corporate financial and operational objectives.
* Review and approve master schedules, budgets, and procurement strategies.
* Establish project performance KPIs, including cost variance, schedule variance, productivity, and margin.



 Project Execution \& Operational Excellence
 


* Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with contractual obligations and company standards.
* Monitor progress across multiple projects and intervene proactively to resolve bottlenecks.
* Ensure effective coordination between engineering, procurement, commercial, and site teams.
* Drive continuous improvement in construction methodologies and resource utilization.
* Ensure strict adherence to approved drawings, specifications, and quality benchmarks.



 Financial \& Commercial Management
 


* Oversee project budgeting, forecasting, and cost control mechanisms.
* Review and approve major variations, subcontractor agreements, and commercial negotiations.
* Safeguard project profitability, cash flow, and margin performance.
* Monitor procurement efficiency and material cost optimization.
* Ensure proper contract administration and claims management practices.



 Risk, Compliance \& Governance
 


* Ensure compliance with UAE construction regulations, safety standards, and contractual requirements.
* Implement enterprise\-level risk mitigation strategies across all active projects.
* Promote and enforce a strong HSE culture with zero\-incident objectives.
* Ensure implementation of quality assurance and quality control systems across sites.



 Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Lead, mentor, and evaluate Project Managers, Construction Managers, and Engineering teams.
* Act as the executive representative for clients, consultants, and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure high levels of client satisfaction through proactive communication and resolution of concerns.
* Strengthen cross\-functional collaboration to ensure seamless project execution.
* Support succession planning and capability development within the project's function.



 Personal Attributes:
 


* Strong leadership qualities with the ability to manage a diverse team and maintain project momentum.
* Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen.
* Results\-driven with a high accountability and ownership mindset.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented with a problem\-solving mindset.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines while maintaining quality standards.
* High level of professionalism and discretion when handling sensitive information.
* Strong commitment to safety and quality on\-site.



  





**Requirements
 
 :** 



* A minimum of 15 to 20 years of progressive experience in construction project management, with a proven track record working with reputable contracting companies in the UAE.
* Proven experience in managing luxury projects,

data.raw_snippet:
**Job Purpose:** 




 The Head of Complex Change is accountable for the hands‑on execution and successful delivery of RAKBANK’s most complex, cross‑functional, and strategically critical transformation programmes. The role owns end‑to‑end delivery outcomes—time, scope, and budget—across multi‑platf
data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




 The Head of Complex Change is accountable for the hands‑on execution and successful delivery of RAKBANK’s most complex, cross‑functional, and strategically critical transformation programmes. The role owns end‑to‑end delivery outcomes—time, scope, and budget—across multi‑platform, multi‑vendor, and multi‑year initiatives with board‑level visibility and CBUAE scrutiny. Acting as the bank’s delivery field commander, the incumbent manages complexity, controls scope, and drives proactive risk mitigation. The role serves as the primary delivery interface with Tier‑1 technology partners and offshore delivery teams, ensuring execution quality and accountability. It requires deep, proven experience in leading large‑scale banking transformations to measurable outcomes.
 



  





  





**What You will Do** 



* Own executive delivery accountability for RAKBANK’s most complex transformation programmes across core banking, digital, payments, and infrastructure.
* Ensure programmes are delivered to committed scope, timelines, and budgets with clear, outcome‑based ownership.
* Lead proactive risk identification and mitigation through deep upfront assessments and a live, senior‑reviewed RAID framework.
* Enforce rigorous scope management and prevent scope creep via disciplined change control and executive escalation.
* Act as the primary delivery interface with Tier‑1 technology partners and vendors, ensuring contractual accountability and milestone delivery.
* Lead and align Offshore Development Centres and offshore delivery teams to programme plans, quality standards, and delivery commitments.
* Design and mobilise complex, multi‑year programme structures, governance forums, and inter‑workstream dependencies.
* Chair programme steering and governance forums, resolving blockers and escalating issues to CTO, ExCo, and CEO as required.
* Coordinate regulatory, audit, compliance, and risk engagement for programmes under CBUAE scrutiny.
* Produce board‑quality, risk‑adjusted programme reporting and build delivery leadership capability across programme managers and change leads.



  





**What You Will Brin** 



* 20\+ years of progressive technology and transformation leadership, with a minimum of 5 years in an EVP, MD, Programme Director, or CXO\-adjacent delivery leadership role within a bank or globally regulated financial institution.
* Demonstrated track record of personally leading and successfully completing multi\-year, cross\-platform transformation programmes in banking — specifically including core banking migration or major platform upgrade, payments modernisation, or digital platform transformation.
* Expert\-level command of upfront risk management, scope control, and delivery governance in complex, multi\-vendor programme environments — with evidence of having prevented or resolved scope creep and delivery crises in prior engagement.
* Proven experience managing Tier\-1 vendor relationships and ODC/offshore delivery partnerships within programme scope — holding external parties to contractual accountability and delivery standard.
* Expert command of enterprise programme governance frameworks (MSP, PMI\-PgMP, or equivalent) and the ability to adapt these pragmatically to the pace and constraints of live banking transformation.
* Experience engaging with central bank regulators (CBUAE, FCA, MAS, or equivalent) on technology change submissions and supervisory engagement, in partnership with governance and compliance function.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA, MSP Practitioner, or PMI\-PgMP certification highly preferred.



  





**What We are Not Looking for:** 




 ❌ A coordinator or status‑reporting PMO profile that tracks plans but does not personally own delivery outcomes, risk decisions, and executive accountability.
 



 ❌ A leader who reacts to issues after escalation, rather than proactively identifying, structuring, and mitigating complex delivery risks upfront.
 



 ❌ A purely theoretical transformation expert with “exposure” to large programmes, but without proven, hands‑on experience delivering multi‑platform banking transformations under board and regulatory scrutiny.

data.jd_text:
**Remobile Group is looking for a Group Operations Manager to help oversee and control daily operations across our growing businesses and teams.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who is highly organised, structured, proactive, and experienced in e\-commerce operations. The right person will work closely with the CEO and team members across different locations to make sure tasks are clearly assigned, deadlines are followed, communication stays organised, and operational issues are reported before they become bigger problems.
 



  





 This is not only an admin role. We are looking for someone who can bring structure, accountability, and follow\-up across multiple teams, offices, and online business operations.
 



  





 About Remobile Group
 



 Remobile Group operates multiple businesses in the mobile phone and consumer electronics industry, including e\-commerce operations, Shopify stores, refurbishment, procurement, sales, marketing, and international teams.
 



  





 The Group Operations Manager will help create one clear operating structure across the company so that all important tasks, projects, and responsibilities are properly tracked and followed up.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 You will be responsible for keeping control of daily tasks and operational follow\-up across Remobile Group. You will make sure tasks are created correctly in ClickUp or Notion, assigned to the right person, given clear deadlines, and followed up until completion.
 



  





 You will also monitor team communication through Slack, ensure important discussions are converted into clear tasks, and keep the CEO updated on progress, delays, bottlenecks, and issues that require attention.
 



  





 The role includes coordinating with employees across different departments and locations, including Pakistan, Dubai, and European operations, while being based hybrid in the Netherlands, Germany, or Poland.
 



  





 You will help prepare daily and weekly operational updates, track overdue tasks, follow up with team members, support meeting preparation, take meeting notes, and make sure every meeting ends with clear action points.
 



  





 You will also support e\-commerce operations by helping teams stay organised around Shopify\-related tasks, product updates, marketing follow\-ups, customer experience issues, stock/pricing coordination, reporting, and general online business execution.
 



  





 What We Are Looking For
 



 We are looking for someone with 2–3 years of experience in e\-commerce operations, operations coordination, project coordination, or business operations.
 



  





 You should have practical experience using ClickUp or Notion for task management and be comfortable using Slack for team communication. You must be able to create structure, follow up professionally, and keep teams accountable without creating unnecessary pressure or confusion.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is organised, reliable, detail\-oriented, and comfortable working directly with senior management. You should be able to understand priorities, follow up on deadlines, identify delays, and clearly report what is completed, what is pending, and what needs CEO attention.**

**INSPIRE \| EXHILARATE \| DELIGHT**
 For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
   

  

 Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
   

  

 Chalhoub Group fosters a people\-at\-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future\-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.
   

  

 Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040\.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The Transformation Program Governance Director provides strategic oversight and leadership across the Group’s multi\-year digital transformation program. This role ensures disciplined execution, strategic alignment, and value realization across all streams, while acting as the guardian of program governance, standards, and vendor accountability. Operating at Group level, this leader drives cross\-entity alignment, embeds best\-in\-class governance frameworks, and establishes the program as a benchmark for disciplined transformation delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Lead executive governance for the entire digital transformation program, strategically allocating resources, budgets, and priorities to maximize business impact.
* Safeguard program outcomes by overseeing benefit realization and hold workstreams accountable for delivering measurable value and results.
* Support and challenge program leaders to ensure delivery excellence, proactively managing risks, dependencies, and barriers.
* Provide senior leadership with data\-driven insights, independent assurance, and strategic recommendations to guide decision\-making.
* Define, document and continuously evolve Group\-wide governance frameworks, standards, and policies to ensure consistent and mature program delivery.
* Establish and maintain a Transformation Governance Center of Excellence (CoE) offering tools, methodologies, and training for standardized delivery.
* Uphold governance rigor by designing and maintaining clear decision\-making structures, reporting mechanisms, and escalation protocols that ensure transparency and accountability at all levels.
* Act as a senior escalation point and manage strategic vendor relationships, ensuring partners meet contractual commitments, quality standards, and timely delivery.
* Shape vendor engagement models and collaborate with Procurement, Legal, and Finance to optimize commercial terms, risk management and cost control across all vendor engagements.
* Ensure alignment across Group entities and business units, so that transformation initiatives are integrated seamlessly into the operating model and enable scalable adoption.
* Drive transparent, timely reporting and foster collaboration across geographies and functions to maintain senior stakeholder engagement and informed executive committees and SteerCos, enabling informed decision\-making and program steering.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Proven experience in leading governance and execution for large\-scale, multi\-year digital transformation programs, ideally in a multi\-entity or international group context.
* Deep expertise in governance design, operating models, and transformation frameworks, with a track record of institutionalizing standards at Group level.
* Strong leadership and influencing skills, with the ability to engage at C\-suite and Board level.
* Demonstrated success in vendor and partner governance, including complex system integrator or technology engagements.
* Strategic thinker with operational discipline, able to balance control, flexibility, and delivery speed.
* Excellent communication, diplomacy, and stakeholder management skills across diverse cultures and functions.


**What We Can Offer You**
 With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.
   

  

 We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
   

  

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**
 To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.
   

  

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**
 It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
   

  

 We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of your Day**
 As a Project Procurement Manager you represent Supply Chain in the Project/Proposal Management Team and acts as the Sub\-project Manager leading the Project SCM strategy for Compressor packages. You will integrate procurement in the project management process and project teams and be involved during the sales phase. You will organize all procurement activities in a project under optimum deployment of resources. You also implement procurement strategies aiming to optimize project results, including availability of goods and services in quality, in time, in budget while ensuring observance of obligatory Procurement processes and regulations.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Early Involvement during sales phase: Analyze sales and operations planning in respect of starting/new projects in order to ensure the involvement of Procurement. Participate in project/sales meetings as project core team member to provide information about supply market, preferred suppliers and supplier innovation (regarding goods and services) at an early stage to optimize supplier strategy and selection of Major CTO and ETO equipment, such as Motors, Gears, Gas Engines, Acoustics equipment, Auxiliaries (Lube Systems, Gas Seal panels, etc); diversified components (Dry Gas Seals, Anti\-Surge Valves, other); extended scope such as WHRU, HRSG, Balance of Plant.
* Project Procurement standards: Establish proper sourcing processes, control all Procurement resources and activities in the project and inform all involved within Procurement to deliver optimum impact for the business (Procurement plan, target\-costing) relating to budget, availability, timeline and quality. Apply Procurement regulations as per Compliance, organization standards and PM@Siemens Energy
* Analysis: Analyze scope of supply, contractual obligations and exactly understand customer’s functional needs.Identify Procurement risks, opportunities, potential changes, claims and market forces during the entire project, together with Commodity Management, to avoid potential damage / exploit potential.
* Strategy definition and implementation: Derive Procurement strategy for assigned projects in accordance with Business Unit \& Operating Company Procurement strategies and ensure implementation. Introduce negotiation recommendations together with Commodity Management to prepare for negotiations with suppliers (back\-to\-back where appropriate) and to initiate appropriate measures.
* Negotiation: Lead complex contractual and price, cash flow and commercial T\&C negotiations and/or support the specialist buyers responsible for particular material fields (in particular those not covered by any Commodity Management) to secure project targets with optimum conditions on the basis of ToCO.
* Contract Management: Ensure that major Procurement risks, changes to original scope of supply and potential claims (towards customers and suppliers) are covered in valid contracts. Ensure that contractual obligations (towards the customer that must be fulfilled by supplier) are covered in a way that mitigates the own risk exposure.
* Supplier Management / Preferred Supplier List: Apply preferred supplier list (e.g. FPL), provide supplier information to the project team, coordinate Supplier Management in preparation for transition to Project execution phase (including Supplier Qualification, project\-specific supplier evaluations and supplier development).
* Knowledge management and documentation: Be proactive and forward systematically all relevant Procurement related project information (e.g. updated contractual conditions, Supplier Management data) to keep all project participants and relevant cross\-functional partners up to date. Share best practice and conduct lessons learn sessions. Sensitize cross\-functional partners for Procurement related practices processes and metrics.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) in an engineering discipline with minimum 5 years of relevant experience; or M.S. degree in engineering discipline with 3 years of relevant experience; or M.B.A with technical B.S. degree with 3 years of relevant experience; or equivalent education and experience.
* Compression and/or Gas Turbine major equipment relevant technical proficiency preferred
* 5 Years experience minimum combined in related SCM functions, Project Procurement, Proposal and/or Project Management within Oil and Gas or Power Generation industry.
* Advanced MS Office applications skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint
* Advanced knowledge of sourcing process
* Advanced negotiation skills
* Good problem solving skills
* Cost Modeling
* Ability to work in a matrix organization
* Advanced data analytics
* Leader, self\-manage
* Ability to run presentations to management level
* Availability to travel estimated 15% of time


**About The Team**
 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform

 As a Technical Project Manager, you will oversee the planning, execution and successful end\-to\-end delivery of implementation projects to our clients. You will join a wider Delivery team of engineers, analysts, data scientists and architects focused on achieving the best outcomes for our clients.

* You are a self\-starter and bring a great deal of determination, initiative and tenacity to your projects.

 What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

 We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We're not a start\-up. Not anymore. But we've not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction \- the future.
   

  

**It's All About You.**
 We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected—because it's your individuality and passion that make you

data.jd_text:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
* Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
* Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
* Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within their section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* This position is responsible for cost containment through the proper use, handling and maintenance of records, reports, supplies and equipment.
* Identifies potential expense reductions through cost control.
* Analyzes operational problems and establishes controls.
* Reviews timesheets and forwards them to the Executive Chef for approval.
* May prepare a variety of reports and letters utilizing personal computer system and equipment.
* Ensures that items are requisitioned in correct quantities, within acceptable timeframes and in accordance with established control procedures.
* Conducts workstation spot checks to ensure items are correctly stored to minimize deterioration and waste.



  





**MOTIVATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Monitors and manages the various assigned workstation functions.
* Monitors the assignment of duties and responsibilities to their staff.
* Observes and evaluates staff and work procedures to ensure quality standards and service are met.
* Makes recommendations regarding personnel actions such as new hire requests and discharges, to ensure adequate and continuous staffing.
* Inspects workstations, work areas, equipment, etc. to ensure efficient service and conformance to standards.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION** 




  




* A minimum of 8 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef de Partie (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries, and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.



  





*Internal Candidate Requirements:* 




 In addition to the stated hiring requirements, internal candidates are required to fulfill the following:
 


* Completion of at least two contracts as Chef Tournant with a performance rating of satisfactory or above, along with demonstrated leadership skills.

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**About the Company**




 The Kleindienst Group is committed to pushing the boundaries of what has been achieved, pioneering new concepts in real estate and hospitality to deliver excellence. Established over 30 years ago in Austria and Hungary and present in Dubai since 2003, The Kleindienst Group is the largest European real estate company in Dubai with more than 1,200 employees over its diverse portfolio of businesses which include property development, construction, hospitality, property brokerage, shipbuilding and corporate business centres.
 



 The Heart of Europe is the flagship masterplan of the developer in Dubai, in The World island 4km from the Dubai coastline. The Heart of Europe is an upscale, sustainable and visionary island mixed\-used destination comprising of 15 hotels and resorts, 4,000 holiday homes and hotel units, the iconic Floating Seahorse Villas, white sandy beaches, and the word’s first climate controlled rainy street and snow plaza. The Heart of Europe is committed to deliver exceptional sustainability and European culture, heritage and lifestyle experiences through architecture, events and innovative technology.
 



 The Heart of Europe, is one of the most intriguing and exciting investments in Dubai today.
 



  





**Job Title: Senior Project Director \- Civil**




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 1\. Project Planning.
 


* Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, procurement, materials, sub\-contracting and resources.
* Work closely with stakeholders to define, project goals, and deliverables.



 2\. Team Leadership and Management:
 


* Lead and manage project teams, including project managers, engineers, technical team, commercial and construction staff.
* Assign responsibilities and set clear objectives, for the team.
* Foster a collaborative and positive working environment.
* Work closely with internal stake holders / departments to facilitate coordinated execution of the works



 3\. Commercial
 


* Work closely with procurement to obtain value for money materials and sub\-contractors
* Approve contracts, purchase orders, and invoices related to the project.



 4\. Project Execution and Monitoring:
 


* Oversee the execution of construction projects, adherence to plans, specifications, and quality standards.
* Conduct regular site visits to monitor progress, identify issues, and compliance with safety regulations.
* Implement corrective actions to address any deviations from project plans.



 5\. Risk Management and Problem Solving:
 


* Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Resolve conflicts and challenges that arise during the project lifecycle.
* Put contingency plans in place for high\-risk activities and activate when necessary.



 6\. Stakeholder Communication and Reporting:
 


* Serve as the primary point of contact for senior management, contractors, and other stakeholders.
* Provide regular updates on project status.
* Conduct meetings with stakeholders to review project milestones and address concerns.



 7\. Compliance and Quality Assurance:
 


* Implement quality control procedures and resources for the project to be constructed in accordance the project design
* Promote QA/QC good practice
* Conduct regular QA/QC review meetings to monitor compliance.



 8\. Health and Safety:
 


* Implement HSE control procedures and resources for the project to be constructed in a safe manner and in compliance with the relevant safety codes, regulations, and safety standards.
* Promote HSE good practice
* Conduct regular HSE review meetings to monitor compliance.



 9\. Project Closeout and Handover:
 


* Oversee the project closeout process, including final inspections, documentation, and handover to the End User.



  





**Essential Requirements**





 Education
 



* ***A bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, architecture, or a related field***




 Years of Experience
 



* ***Minimum 15 years of experience in the construction industry preferably hospitality including:***
* ***10\+ years of experience in project management, with at least 5 years leading 5 star hotel projects while working for a main contracting firm.***
* Preferred to have involved in Hotel Development from start to end in last 5 years.
* Experience should cover various aspects of construction, including project planning, budgeting, scheduling, risk management, and team leadership.




 Leadership Experience
 



* Proven experience in managing teams and leading projects from inception to completion is crucial. This includes experience in managing project budgets, schedules, and stakeholder relationships.




 Skills and Competencies:
 



* Project Management Skills: Strong skills in project planning, risk management, and contract administration are essential.
* Financial Acumen: Ability to manage large budgets, control costs, and perform financial forecasting.
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills are necessary for coordinating with clients, stakeholders, and team members.
* Problem\-Solving: Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities to address and resolve issues as they arise.
* Leadership and Team Management: Proven ability to lead and motivate teams, manage conflicts, and ensure project objectives are met.
* Knowledge of Industry Standards: Familiarity with construction codes, regulations, and best practices.

data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company’s three core products are Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world; Lens Studio, an augmented reality platform that powers AR across Snapchat and other services; and its AR glasses, Spectacles.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.
   

  

 "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

data.jd_text:
**Istituto Marangoni Duba** 
 i is seeking a full\-time
 **Course Coordinator** 
 within the Interior Design area to join its academic team. The role contributes to teaching, student development, academic coordination, administration, and industry engagement across the
 **BA and MA Interior Design programmes** 
 and related activities.
   

  

 The ideal candidate
 **will hold a PhD, have at least 3 years of teaching experience in an international higher education setting** 
 , possess UAE Ministry of Education qualification equivalency, have proven professional experience in the interior design industry, and demonstrate strong academic, organizational, communication, and industry networking skills.
   

  

**Key Purpose of the Role**
 To support the delivery and development of high\-quality teaching within the Interior Design area, ensuring student progression, academic excellence, effective coordination across courses and tutors, and strong industry connectivity, in alignment with institutional and CAA standards. The role also requires strong familiarity with international industry standards and the ability to effectively transfer this knowledge to students through teaching, mentoring, and project\-based learning.
   

  

**Areas of Expertise**
 Candidates should demonstrate expertise in one or more of the following areas:
   

  

* Interior Design and Architecture
* Lighting Design
* Visual Communication
* History of Interior Design
* Interior Design Research
* Digital Tools for Design
* Portfolio Layout
* Building Materials and Technology
* Furniture Design
* Creative Technologies
* Professional Practice


**Key Responsibilities**
* Teaching and Academic Delivery
* Deliver assigned subjects through a clear, student\-centered approach, in compliance with CAA standards
* Prepare teaching materials in line with Istituto Marangoni’s methodological guidelines and the direction of Program Leaders in MA and BA and the Director of Education
* Coordinate among Tutors, collect and maintain course files and related academic documentation
* Carry out course coordination required to support teaching, learning, and academic development in coordination with Program Leaders of MA and BA
* Contribute to the academic and creative culture of the University through lectures, projects, events, and cross\-school initiatives
* Student Academic Support
* Support student learning progress and monitor academic development, student experience, and progression
* Assess student progression through formative and summative assessment across the academic year
* Encourage creativity, engagement, and problem\-solving through group work, field trips, and industry\-supported projects in coordination with Program Leaders of MA and BA areas
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with students, lecturers, staff, and academic leadership
* Course and Project Coordination
* Monitor semester projects in alignment with MA and BA Program Leaders, ensuring cross\-subject integration, academic coherence, and effective delivery in accordance with defined PLOs, CLOs, and overall program frameworks.
* Support the Program Leaders of MA and BA to develop and implement the semester framework across classes
* Facilitate alignment between Program Leaders MA and BA and tutors teaching within shared project structures in line with CLOs and PLOs
* Support the coordination of industry projects, ensuring clarity of communication, expectations, and timelines
* Maintain strong communication between tutor teams and the Programme Leaders of MA and BA areas
* Contribute to the overall quality, consistency, and smooth operation of semester and industry\-based projects
* Industry Engagement
* Support engagement with relevant industries, organizations, and professional bodies
* Contribute to support opportunities for collaboration that strengthen the program and the University
* Support the development of projects and partnerships that connect academic delivery with professional practice


**Educational And Professional Requirements**
* PhD in one or more of the areas of expertise listed above
* Minimum 3 years of teaching experience in an international institution, at university level
* Education qualification equivalency from the Ministry of Education in the United Arab Emirates

data.jd_text:
**The Executive Director of Enrollment Management (EDEM)** 
 is responsible for developing and implementing strategic initiatives to promote American University of Sharjah (AUS), advance its mission, and position it as a premier institution of choice for qualified local and international students.
   

  

 The EDEM provides leadership and oversight for key enrollment functions, including:
   

  

* Undergraduate (UG) and graduate (GR) student recruitment and admissions
* The University Testing Center
* The external sponsorships program
* The Welcome Center
* The Contact Center


 Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders, the EDEM ensures alignment with the university’s strategic objectives. This includes conducting periodic assessments, research, and analyses of the higher education landscape to inform data\-driven enrollment strategies and meet institutional targets. Additionally, the EDEM prepares annual enrollment projections to support budget planning.
   

  

 Externally, the EDEM fosters strategic partnerships with Ministries of Education/Higher Education, government agencies, sponsoring entities, high schools, and higher education institutions within and beyond the UAE to strengthen AUS’s enrollment pipeline and reputation.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Oversee the development and implementation of the Office of Enrollment Management (OEM) Multi\-Year Strategic Plan.
* Track inquiries, leads, yields, and application trends to guide decision\-making and improve efficiency.
* Serve on various committees to formulate leveraging strategies, including those related to student success, recruitment and retention, financial grants and scholarships, and a university capacity task force.
* Supervise the planning and execution of the new student orientation program.
* Prepare and maintain the departmental budget, ensuring alignment with institutional strategic enrollment goals and objectives.
* Analyze admission standards and requirements and recommend adjustments for approval by senior leadership.
* Develop print and online informational and promotional materials.
* Serve as the final arbiter on admissions decisions in accordance with established policies.
* Advocate for fair admission policies and ensure equitable treatment of all applicants regardless of background.
* Develop grade concordance tables and matrices for different secondary education systems.
* Establish and monitor the application of academic credential evaluation and assessment standards.
* Monitor the effectiveness of internal admissions processes and policies to ensure they meet key performance indicators.
* Liaise with Ministries of Education and local education councils.
* Develop data\-driven, multi\-year enrollment projection scenarios to establish capacity parameters and budgetary requirements.
* Monitor and assess the growth of the external student sponsorship program and strengthen relationships with sponsoring organizations.
* Represent the university at media events and on\- and off\-campus recruitment functions.
* Develop a recruitment and new\-student communications plan, guiding prospects from initial inquiry through matriculation.
* Develop and implement, in consultation with the recruitment team, an annual comprehensive recruitment campaign plan.
* Co\-manage, with the Strategic Communications and Marketing department, the development of communication plans and the implementation of promotional tools for recruitment campaigns (e.g., social media, advertising).
* Engage colleges/schools, faculty, alumni, and various AUS departments in recruitment efforts to achieve enrollment goals.
* Establish partnership agreements with select high schools locally and internationally to attract highly qualified applicants.
* Lead the integration of automation and artificial intelligence solutions to enhance enrollment operations, improve applicant experience, increase efficiency, and transition key processes from manual to data\-driven digital workflows.


**Qualifications And Skills Required**
* Master’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Mass Communication, Public Administration, Higher Education Administration, or a related field from an accredited institution.
* Proficiency in written and spoken Arabic is considered an asset.
* Strong understanding of the higher education landscape, including emerging trends, regulatory frameworks, and best practices in enrollment management.
* Solid background in developing and implementing admissions policies, academic credential evaluation standards, and related governance frameworks.
* Comprehensive knowledge of diverse high school education systems, grading models, student recruitment strategies, and yield management practices.
* Up\-to\-date expertise in leveraging digital marketing, social media, branding strategies, and evolving demographic trends to support enrollment growth.
* Understanding of the relationship between enrollment strategies and student retention, persistence, and graduation outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to develop accurate enrollment projections and execute long\-term enrollment strategies aligned with institutional goals.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills.
* Effective and focused leader with a proven ability to build and motivate high\-performing teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong stakeholder engagement and relationship\-building capabilities.
* Proven ability to manage budgets efficiently and optimize resource allocation.
* Proficiency in enrollment management systems, data analytics and visualization tools, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong crisis management and change management capabilities.
* Visionary, innovative, and adaptable leadership style.
* Persuasive, collaborative, and culturally sensitive.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with sound judgment.
* Demonstrates integrity, transparency, fairness, and ethical leadership
* Expert in enrollment data analysis, predictive modeling, CRM tools, and admissions software.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in Higher Education Administration and Management.


**How To Apply**
* Interested applicants should fill out the form.
* AUS alumni are encouraged to apply. Applicants who do not meet specified requirements will not be shortlisted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
* AUS is an equal opportunity employer. We adhere to a policy of making employment decisions without regard to race, color, age, gender, religion, national origin, disability or marital status. Opportunities for employment are based solely upon one’s qualifications.

**Description**
 Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) Program Manager for its AMET operations team. The candidate should enjoy getting their hands dirty, and looking around the corners for solutions with the aim of optimization of OTR operations in Amazon’s last mile delivery stations.
   

  

 As an ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) program manager, you will be the subject matter expert for UTR and OTR operations driving capacity enhancements and utilization improvements in both.
   

  

 You will be a subject matter expert on routing and sortation operations and accountable for RUBL60 and sort grid utilization metrics. You should be able to think big to solve complex problems with simple and practical solutions by developing a deep knowledge of the operation processes.
   

  

 This role calls for an individual who can own all aspects of how transportation impacts customer experience, shipper experience and operator experience; monitor metrics, determine, then drive any initiatives necessary to improve it. It requires an individual to showcase judgement and decision\-making skills to balance customer experience with financial impact. This position offers a broad exposure to various business, financial, and technical teams within Amazon.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a person who enjoys and excels at dealing with ambiguity and design and define products/programs with little information. He / She will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to create and sustain urgency, and a proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects including communication across all levels and teams in the organization: senior leaders, technical teams, finance, business, and operations leaders.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As UTR and OTR capacity SME, you will responsible for:
   

  

* Driving (accountable) RUBL60 and Sort Grid utilization metrics across MEATR region.
* Invent solutions to solve complex business problems.
* Provide corresponding tools to support Central Ops.
* Build mechanisms and monitor RUBL60 and Bag utilization metrics on a daily basis. Identify root causes and corrective/preventive actions for misses.
* Discuss trends and unusual behaviors of the RUBL60 and bag utilization metric.
* Provide sustainable solutions and effective guidance across the organization.
* Leverage route planning metrics to define, characterize areas of improvement.
* Collaborate with Tech/Science teams to enhance route planning systems.
* Aim to produce routes that are efficient and maximize the time utilization without impacting drivers' workload.
* Influence Route Planning teams to build models that generate fair, sustainable, and efficient delivery routes.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

**Company Description**
 At QIMA, we are on a mission to offer our clients smart solutions to make products you can trust.
   

  

 Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence.

With client passion, integrity, and a commitment to making things simple, we disrupted the Testing, Inspection, and Certification industry. Are you ready to hop on this exciting ride with us and help us achieve our mission?
   

  

 Our Consumer Products Division is dedicated to helping brands, retailers and manufacturers worldwide deliver safe, quality and ethically made products to their consumers. Every day at work, our inspectors, auditors, lab techs, and certification specialists use their expertise to help safeguard the products you use every day in your home: from clothes and footwear to toys and baby products, to electronics, appliances, and furniture.

This role will report directly to the Head of Certification Unit working as part of our Client Service \& Program team.
   

  

 The purpose of QIMA’s Client Service \& Program team is to deliver seamless certification experience to our clients by managing key programs and ensuring the highest standards of client satisfaction.

* Supervise the Program Management \& Client Service Team and ensure continuous monitoring of service quality and operational efficiency.
* Manage and maintain client relationships to enhance the customer service experience, ensuring service quality and efficient operations.
* Identify and seek further business opportunities while developing relationships with new clients.
* Oversee client’s programs and maintain understanding of regulatory program requirements including SASO, GSO, SFDA, and MOAIT.
* Support the Sales Team to resolve client enquiries and problems with consistency and accuracy.
* Handle ad\-hoc assignments as required.
* Champion an AI\-first mindset by promoting the use of AI tools and technologies in day\-to\-day operations and encouraging experimentation and adoption of AI\-driven solutions to improve efficiency, strengthen processes, and elevate service quality.


**Qualifications**
**To succeed in this role, you have:**
* Diploma or degree holder in any discipline; Electrical, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering background is a plus.
* Fluent in written and spoken English; Chinese or Arabic speaking is an advantage and preferable.
* 5\+ years of working experience in operations and client service within a certification body; experience in testing laboratory management and in\-depth technical knowledge are an advantage.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in managing a team, customer service, and client management.
* Self\-initiated, independent, and a good team player.
* 5\+ years of total experience; experience in certification bodies with team management responsibilities is highly valued.
* Familiarity with regulatory programs such as SASO, GSO, SFDA, and MOAIT is a strong advantage.
* A genuine enthusiasm for Artificial Intelligence and its practical applications in operations, quality control, or client management; experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity and decision\-making is a strong plus.


**Additional Information**
 Because our differences make the difference, at QIMA we are proud to promote inclusive diversity and equal opportunities! Our policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

**Overview**
 Manager – Planning \& Business Solutions for Energy \& Projects vertical supports the execution and delivery of AIT’s Energy \& Projects (E\&P) solutions strategy within the IMEA region. The role focuses on commercial execution, customer support, operational coordination, and product deployment, contributing to sustainable and profitable growth in line with regional and corporate objectives.
   

  

 The Manager partners closely with the Director – Energy \& Projects, regional leadership, and cross‑functional teams to support business development initiatives, ensure operational excellence, and maintain strong relationships with customers and service providers involved in complex Energy and Project logistics solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and coordinate end‑to‑end execution of Energy, Oil \& Gas, and Project Cargo movements across India \& Middle East region, ensuring safety, regulatory compliance, and on‑time delivery.
* Serve as the operational and technical subject‑matter expert for Energy \& Project cargo, including OOG, breakbulk, modules, skids, and engineered movements supporting upstream, midstream, and downstream projects.
* Manage routing, carrier selection, vessel planning, equipment configuration, permits, surveys, and method‑of‑transport execution in alignment with approved SOPs, HSE plans, and EPC requirements.
* Coordinate carriers, heavy‑haul and SPMT providers, ports, terminals, yards, and third‑party service providers to ensure capacity availability, service continuity, and effective risk mitigation in Oil \& Gas environments.
* Monitor shipment‑ and project‑level cost performance, supporting margin integrity and compliance with approved commercial frameworks and customer contractual requirements.
* Support tender execution for Energy \& Oil \& Gas projects through operational feasibility assessments, execution methodology reviews, and pricing inputs within defined authority limits.
* Collaborate with regional pricing and procurement teams to validate rates, equipment availability, and market conditions, sharing intelligence on carrier capacity and cost drivers within the Energy sector.
* Track operational KPIs related to safety, schedule adherence, cost control, and execution quality, implementing corrective actions for deviations.
* Act as a first‑level operational escalation point for complex, high‑risk, or cross‑border Energy \& Project shipments, including shutdowns, critical\-path cargo, and remote site deliveries.
* Ensure full compliance with HSE, DG, project QA/QC standards, and customer‑specific Oil \& Gas and Energy project requirements.
* Collaborate with regional leadership, sales, engineering, and operations teams to improve execution capability, standardization, and delivery performance across Energy \& Projects programs.

* Customer service focus – we serve a wide variety of customers, both internal and external, and building relationships is a part of our culture!


**Other Skills We Hope To See**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 8–12 years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding, or project cargo, within Energy or Industrial Projects.
* Experience supporting P\&L performance, pricing, or commercial activities.
* Exposure to Air, Ocean, and Project logistics operations.
* Experience working across multiple stakeholders and geographies preferred.
* Strong coordination, communication, and problem‑solving skills.
* Process‑oriented with attention to detail and compliance requirements.
* Demonstrate a great deal of initiative and a strong hands\-on mentality
* High customer and service orientation
* High ability to work under pressure in a matrix environment and willingness to travel
* Demonstrates sound judgment and the ability to operate effectively in complex, high‑risk environments.


**About AIT Worldwide**
 AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps its customers grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure raw materials, components, and finished goods. Backed by scalable, user\-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door\-to\-door deliveries via sea, air, ground, and rail—on time and on budget. With expert teammates staffing more than 100 worldwide locations in Asia, Europe, India, and North America, AIT’s full\-service options also include customs clearance, warehouse management and white glove services. Learn more about AIT Worldwide Logistics, our culture and core values in action here .
