data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

data.jd_text:
**Introduction To Role**
 The International region is AstraZeneca’s largest, most diverse and fastest\-growing region, representing around one\-third of total company revenue. Spanning more than 90 countries across five continents, it covers over 70% of the world’s population. International is not “Rest of World” — it is “Most of World” — and with that scale comes a profound responsibility to patients, as the burden of non\-communicable disease and mortality is disproportionately high across our markets. International is a critical growth engine for AstraZeneca, delivering double\-digit growth across all therapy areas and playing a central role in the company’s future success. We operate in a complex, rapidly evolving environment — and we are doubling down on growth and pipeline delivery to make Ambition 2030 a reality in International. At the heart of this is how we use AI, digital and data to transform our company, accelerate our science and maximize our impact for patients.
 *Ready to influence how a major global business runs its future?*
 We are looking for a dynamic individual to fulfil the role of
 **Senior Director, Digital \& AI for Analytics and Process Transformation, International** 
 . The successful candidate will be accountable for re\-wiring critical process to simplify and accelerate through AI and automation, starting with key performance analytics and annual business cycle processes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be capable of navigating a senior leadership environment, securing progress with minimal direction, and showcasing proactive initiative.  We are seeking an experienced Corporate Tax Director to lead complex engagements across the UAE, advising multinational groups, regional conglomerates, family offices and sovereign wealth funds on UAE Corporate Tax and related advisory matters.  You will support the Corporate Tax Partners and lead and oversee a diverse portfolio covering advisory, compliance, controversy, and transactions: 
 



 Client leadership and advisory

 Engagement delivery and quality

 Market development

* Foster collaboration across service lines (TP, Deals, Legal, Audit, Consulting) to deliver integrated solutions and develop next‑generation leaders.



 Risk, ethics, and operations 
 


* Uphold the firm’s quality, independence, confidentiality, and information security standards; proactively manage engagement risks and escalation protocols.
* Ensure accurate WIP, billing, and cash collection; deliver profitable growth against targets.


**What You’ll Bring** 

**Qualifications and experience** 



* 12\+ years of relevant corporate/international tax experience, with significant time in a Big Four or leading law/consulting firm; strong UAE/GCC exposure required.
* Deep technical command of UAE Corporate Tax law and guidance.
* Proven track record leading large, multi‑jurisdictional engagements and managing senior client stakeholders.
* Demonstrable business development success, with experience originating and closing sizable advisory projects.
* Strong understanding of IFRS tax accounting (IAS 12\) and reporting for groups; familiarity with GloBE deferred tax, safe harbours, and data requirements will be an advantage.
* Experience with Revenue Authority interactions, audits, rulings/clarifications, and dispute strategies will be an advantage.



**Education and professional credentials** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Law, Economics, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
* Recognised tax/accounting qualification preferred (e.g., ADIT, CTA, ACA, CPA, CFA, or equivalent).
* Arabic language skills are advantageous; fluency in English is required.



**Technical and leadership competencies** 



* Expert written and oral communication, with the ability to translate complex rules into pragmatic, commercially grounded advice.
* Strong financial modelling and data literacy; ability to guide clients on tax data, systems, and controls, including Pillar Two data readiness.
* High judgment and negotiation skills; capable of defending positions and navigating regulatory dialogue.
* Inclusive leadership, team building, and coaching at scale; resilient under pressure with excellent project management discipline.



**Technology and data** 




 You are proficient with MS Office and tax compliance platforms, and familiar with data extraction and transformation for tax compliance and reporting. You are comfortable utilising and developing market leading tax technology to support your role and deliver value to our clients, including AI, automation and analytics. 
 


**How You’ll Make a Difference**

**Why You’ll Love Working at PwC**

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well\-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:**




 To lead exhibition and sponsorship sales delivery for AixEnergy Asia 2026, owning the commercial pipeline end\-to\-end and converting it into contracted revenue against the budget target. The Commercial Director carries an individual revenue number, manages the AixEnergy agent network, and works alongside the VP to close exhibition packages, sponsorship inventory, and feature areas. The role is the senior commercial operator on the AixEnergy team and is accountable for the Year 1 close and the Year 2 rebooking pipeline captured on\-site plus any additional AixEnergy edition launches.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:**




 Own the AixEnergy Asia 2026 exhibition and sponsorship pipeline end\-to\-end: prospecting, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and contract close. Carry an individual revenue target and report progress weekly against the Revenue Pathway forecast.
 



 Open and convert priority accounts across hyperscalers, data centre operators, energy and utility companies, EPCs, industrial real estate developers, and AI infrastructure vendors. Build credible peer\-level relationships with senior commercial decision\-makers and convert verbal interest into signed contracts.
 



  





 Manage and grow the AixEnergy agent network. Set agent targets, brief on pricing and proposition, and quality\-control agent\-sourced leads before they enter the AixEnergy pipeline.
 



 Work on sponsorship sales to convert sponsorship inventory: title partner, strategic partners, theatre and feature sponsorships, and on\-site activations.
 



  





 Maintain Salesforce hygiene to dmg events standard: every opportunity logged, staged, weighted, and updated weekly. Provide accurate weekly forecasts to the VP and into the WSR (Weekly Sales Report) cadence, with clear flags on slipped, won, and at\-risk deals.
 



  





 Maintain working knowledge of the AI infrastructure and energy markets: track competitor events, pricing benchmarks, exhibitor movements, and account\-level developments that affect AixEnergy's pipeline and pricing. Feed market intelligence back into the proposition and the floor plan.
 



 Work closely with Marketing, Operations, Content, and Finance to ensure the commercial pipeline is fed, supported, and delivered. Brief Marketing on priority targets and EDM cadence; align with Operations on floor plan, build, and exhibitor delivery; coordinate with Finance on contracting, invoicing, and collections.
 



  





 Deliver a strong on\-site rebooking result for AixEnergy 2027, including target rebooking rate (40%\+) by end of show, signed Letters of Intent for 2027, and a qualified Year 2 pipeline document handed to the team within 30 days of the close of the 2026 edition.
 



  





**Job Context:**




 AixEnergy Asia 2026 is a launch\-edition event. **Job Description**
 The Associate Director / Technical Director – Rail will provide senior technical leadership across multidisciplinary rail projects while helping to grow the rail business in the UAE and wider Middle East market.
   

  

 The role requires broad experience across rail design and delivery, including track, civil works, stations, systems, signalling, power and operations, together with proven delivery of major rail programmes such as high\-speed rail, metro and light rail in regional and international markets.
   

  

 This position suits an experienced rail leader with strong technical credibility, established client relationships, and the ability to support project delivery, technical assurance and work\-winning across the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Design Governance**
* Provide senior technical leadership and act as technical authority, or deputy where appropriate, on rail projects in the UAE and across the Middle East.
* Define and uphold technical standards, design principles and governance processes in line with UAE and regional authority requirements.
* Lead the delivery of multidisciplinary rail design projects as Project Director, Project Manager or Subject Matter Expert, as required.
* Lead multidisciplinary design reviews, technical approvals and assurance activities across complex rail programmes.
* Ensure compliance with international standards and regional regulations, codes and approvals processes.


**Multidisciplinary Rail Design Oversight**
 Provide technical oversight and coordination across all rail disciplines, including:
   

  

* Track \& Alignment
* Civil \& Structural Works (bridges, viaducts, tunnels, earthworks)
* Stations \& Buildings (architecture, MEP, fire \& life safety)
* Rail Systems (signalling, traction power, OCS, substations, SCADA)
* Communications \& Telecoms
* Depots \& Rolling Stock Interfaces
* Systems Integration, Interfaces \& RAMS


 Ensure coordination and technical consistency across disciplines to deliver safe, operable and integrated rail systems.
   

  

**Business Development \& Client Engagement**
* Play a leading role in business development and work\-winning across the Middle East rail market.
* Shape bid strategies, technical solutions, delivery methodologies and fee proposals for priority rail opportunities.
* Act as a senior technical representative in client meetings, workshops, presentations and bid interviews.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with government entities, rail authorities, operators, developers and contractors across the UAE and wider region.
* Contribute to pipeline growth, key account development, market intelligence and strategic positioning for rail in the Middle East.


**Project Delivery Support**
* Work with Project Directors and discipline leads to support the successful delivery of major rail programmes across the UAE and Middle East.
* Resolve complex technical, interface and systems integration issues across multidisciplinary rail projects.
* Support technical review of contractor submissions, authority submissions and design deliverables.
* Provide technical input during construction, testing and commissioning phases where required.
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**Quality, Safety \& Risk**
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**People \& Capability Development**
* Mentor and develop engineers and discipline leads across the Middle East rail team.
* Collaborate effectively with global rail colleagues and contribute to cross\-region technical excellence.
* Support recruitment, succession planning and capability growth to meet the expanding Middle East rail market.
* Promote knowledge sharing, lessons learned and regional best practice across the business.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Civil, Railway or Systems Engineering; a Master’s degree is advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer status, or the ability to demonstrate progress toward chartership.
* Typically 15 to 18\+ years of experience in rail engineering and rail design consultancy.
* Proven rail project experience in the UAE and/or Middle East, including familiarity with regional authorities, standards and approvals processes.
* Strong multidisciplinary rail background with experience across the full project lifecycle and a track record of rail design and delivery.
* Experience leading bids, proposals, client engagement and business development activities.
* Ability to operate confidently in a client\-facing technical leadership role.
* Strong technical credibility across rail disciplines, with systems\-thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience supporting bids, client frameworks and market growth.
* Client\-focused, collaborative and credible with senior stakeholders.
* Clear communicator with the ability to influence clients, partners and internal stakeholders.
* Experience working across both regional and international rail programmes, including high\-speed rail, metro and light rail.
* Established relationships with key regional rail clients, authorities or delivery partners would be advantageous.

data.jd_text:
Ciel Dubai Marina, Vignette Collection is a lifestyle luxury hotel located in the Dubai Marina district of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Standing at 377 meters, Ciel is the tallest hotel in the world boasting 1,004 guestrooms featuring floor\-to\-ceiling panoramic glass windows, eight dining destinations, three outdoor swimming pools including one of the world's highest infinity pools, a luxury spa, and a state\-of\-the\-art gymnasium. Designed by award\-winning architects Norr, the skyscraper is a global symbol of modern engineering and luxury.
   

  

 Ciel is strategically located at the gateway to Dubai Marina, offering direct access to key tourist attractions, beaches, retail centres, and transport networks. The property was developed by The First Group, a renowned UAE\-based global property investment firm and is part of IHG Hotels \& Resorts’ Vignette Collection. Discover more at https//www.vignettecollectionhotels.com/cieldubai.
   

  

 The First Group Hospitality is a Dubai\-headquartered, full\-service hospitality management company specialising in hotel operations, asset management, and F\&B strategy. With a team of industry veterans and a proven track record, the company delivers tailored solutions that enhance efficiency, optimise revenue, and maximise asset value for investors and hotel owners. As a trusted third\-party hotel management provider, The First Group Hospitality partners with leading global brands to drive operational excellence and long\-term profitability, thanks to expertise spanning property performance optimisation, cost management, and guest experience enhancement.
   

  

 Beyond management, The First Group Hospitality develops and operates a dynamic portfolio of upscale hotels, residences, and award\-winning restaurants, creating high\-value hospitality assets that stand out in the market. For more information, visit tfghospitality.com
   

  

 The Senior Commercial Director is responsible for setting, leading and delivering the full commercial strategy for the Ciel Dubai Marina \- Vignette Collection by IHG. Working directly with the Managing Director, hotel leadership teams and above\-property/shared\-service teams, this role is accountable for commercial growth across rooms, food and beverage, meetings and events, and all relevant ancillary revenue streams.
   

  

 The role has clear accountability for RevPAR, market share, total revenue, profitability\-aligned growth, brand\-aligned commercial execution and the development of a high\-performing commercial culture across the organization. The ideal candidate is a proven commercial leader with successful experience in a similar hotel organization and a demonstrated track record of managing luxury lifestyle in a complex environment as well as critical asset importance.
   

  

 Sales and Marketing Teams report directly to the Senior Commercial Director, ensuring clear ownership of demand generation, brand activation, commercial execution and revenue delivery across all commercial disciplines.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Commercial Strategy and Leadership**
* Develop, lead and execute the hotel strategy ensuring alignment with ownership objectives, brand standards, annual budgets and hotel business plans.
* Act as the senior commercial partner to the Managing Director, providing clear recommendations on business mix, pricing, demand generation, channel strategy and growth opportunities.
* Translate objectives into measurable commercial action plans with clear ownership, timelines and performance expectations.
* Create a strong commercial culture across the organization, ensuring hotel teams understand market opportunities, revenue priorities and their role in driving commercial results.


**RevPAR, Total Revenue and Market Share Growth**
* Drive RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, market share and total revenue growth across the asset through disciplined commercial planning and execution.
* Lead total hotel revenue opportunities across rooms, food and beverage, groups, meetings and events, long\-stay, corporate, leisure and ancillary revenue streams.
* Work closely with revenue management teams to optimize pricing, inventory controls, restrictions, forecasting, segmentation and channel mix.
* Identify demand gaps and growth opportunities by monitoring market trends, competitor activity, city\-wide events, source markets and changing customer behaviour.
* Ensure commercial decisions are profitability\-aligned, balancing revenue growth with distribution costs, margin impact and long\-term account value.


**Sales, Marketing, Distribution and Brand Activation**
* Lead the overall sales strategy across key segments including corporate, leisure, groups, MICE, wholesale, consortia, travel trade, OTA and direct channels.
* Ensure strategic account management disciplines are in place, including account plans, production reviews, relationship mapping, conversion tracking and measurable action plans.
* Oversee commercial input into marketing, PR, digital, e\-commerce, CRM, loyalty and promotional campaigns to drive demand and conversion for each hotel.
* Maximize the use of IHG commercial platforms, Vignette Collection brand opportunities, distribution systems, loyalty channels and shared\-service resources.
* Prioritize Brand.com and overall direct business revenue generation, increasing direct booking contribution, improving channel profitability and reducing reliance on third\-party channels where commercially appropriate.
* Further leverage One Rewards, IHG's loyalty ecosystem and the Vignette Collection brand platform to capture direct business, drive member engagement, strengthen repeat demand and grow loyalty\-led revenue across the portfolio.
* Provide direct leadership and accountability for Sales and Marketing teams, ensuring both functions are aligned behind the hotel commercial strategy, revenue targets and brand priorities.
* Represent the hotel at asset management reviews, key client meetings, brand reviews, trade events, sales missions and commercial forums when required.


**Team Management and Performance**
* Lead, coach and develop commercial teams and relevant on\-property colleagues, creating a results\-driven and collaborative working environment.
* Set clear individual and team KPIs, monitor performance regularly and provide timely feedback, coaching and corrective action where needed.
* Build team capability through training, succession planning, best\-practice sharing and consistent commercial routines.
* Ensure strong communication and coordination between sales, revenue, marketing, reservations, events, F\&B and hotel operations teams.
* Direct the Sales Leader and Marketing Leader with clearly defined responsibilities, reporting routines, KPIs and accountability for revenue\-generating activities.


**Above\-Property and Shared\-Service Collaboration**
* Build strong and productive relationships with above\-property and shared\-service teams, including IHG/brand commercial support, revenue management, digital, distribution, reservations, loyalty, PR and marketing resources.
* Influence and coordinate shared\-service support to ensure hotel priorities are understood, actioned and measured against expected results.
* Translate above\-property initiatives into property\-level execution, ensuring hotel receives the right level of commercial focus and follow\-through.
* Escalate risks, opportunities and resources needs clearly to the Managing Director and senior leadership team.


**Business Planning, Reporting and Analysis**
* Lead and contribute to annual business planning, budgeting, forecasting and commercial reviews.
* Prepare clear commercial reports and presentations for the Managing Director, senior management and relevant stakeholders.
* Use data from PMS, CRS, RMS, CRM, sales reporting and business intelligence tools to identify trends, risks and actionable opportunities.
* Track progress against commercial plans, revenue targets, pace, pickup, conversion, account production and campaign performance.


**Operational and Stakeholder Alignment**
* Work closely with hotel operations teams to ensure commercial promises are aligned with guest experience, service delivery and operational capacity.
* Partner with food and beverage leaders to create demand, packages, promotions and partnerships that grow total revenue and enhance hotel positioning.
* Maintain strong relationships with asset management/owners, brand representatives, key clients, partners and internal stakeholders to support long\-term commercial success.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* RevPAR, ADR, occupancy and market share index performance.
* Total revenue delivery, including rooms, food and beverage, meetings and events, and ancillary revenue versus budget and forecast.
* Sales productivity, account penetration, conversion, pipeline quality and business mix improvement.
* Channel mix optimization, direct booking contribution, loyalty performance and distribution cost efficiency.
* com production, direct business revenue contribution, One Rewards and loyalty contribution, member engagement and repeat demand.
* Forecast accuracy, pricing discipline, commercial plan execution and speed of corrective action.
* Team engagement, talent development and quality of collaboration with hotel leadership and shared\-service teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Hospitality Management, Commercial Strategy, Marketing or a related field; master’s degree or relevant certification is an advantage.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive hotel commercial, sales, revenue, distribution or marketing leadership experience, including 3\-5 years in a senior commercial role.
* Proven track record of delivering RevPAR, total revenue, market share, Brand.com/direct\-channel growth, loyalty revenue and profitable commercial performance.
* Prior international chain with lifestyle brand experience is strongly preferred.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen across rooms, F\&B, groups, events, pricing, segmentation, distribution, digital/e\-commerce, CRM, brand marketing and demand generation.
* Proven ability to lead Sales and Marketing teams, with clear reporting lines, KPIs, performance routines, coaching and accountability across a multi\-property environment.

data.jd_text:
Role: Service Delivery Head
   

  

 Department: IT Infrastructure Managed Services
   

  

 Location: Dubai
   

  

 Reports To: Head of: Business / CEO
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-Time, Permanent
   

  

 Experience Required: 20\+ Years
   

  

 Travel Requirements: As required by business
   

  

 The Service Delivery Head is a senior executive role responsible for the end\-to\-end ownership, governance, and growth of all Managed Services accounts within the IT Infrastructure business. This leader will serve as the primary custodian of service quality, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence across a broad portfolio of enterprise and mid\-market clients. This role demands a hands\-on, results\-driven leader who combines deep technical expertise across infrastructure domains with exceptional people management and strategic customer relationship skills. The ideal candidate will have traversed the full spectrum of IT operations from the data center floor to the boardroom and will bring both the credibility and the gravitas to lead large, diverse delivery teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Service Delivery \& Operations Management


 ■ Own and drive the end\-to\-end delivery of all Managed Services across the client portfolio, ensuring SLA/KPI adherence and continuous service improvement.
   

  

 ■ Provide executive oversight for 24x7 operations including NOC, Service Desk, End User Computing, Data Center, and Field Services.
   

  

 ■ Establish, monitor, and refine operational frameworks, escalation procedures, and incident/problem/change management processes aligned to ITIL best practices.
   

  

 ■ Drive regular service reviews with clients, presenting performance metrics, RCA reports, and roadmaps for improvement.
   

  

 ■ Champion automation, tooling, and process efficiency initiatives to reduce operational toil and improve delivery margins.
   

  

* Service Transition \& Onboarding


 ■ Lead and govern the Service Transition function for new account onboarding and contract renewals, ensuring seamless handover from presales/solutioning to steady\-state operations.
   

  

 ■ Define and own transition plans, RACI matrices, risk registers, and knowledge transfer frameworks.
   

  

 ■ Ensure all technical baselines, runbooks, and operational documentation are in place prior to go\-live.
   

  

 ■ Conduct post\-transition reviews and drive lessons\-learned into repeatable delivery models.
   

  

* Customer Relationship Management


 ■ Act as the executive point of escalation and relationship owner for all Managed Services clients.
   

  

 ■ Build and sustain trusted advisor relationships with CIOs, IT Directors, and procurement stakeholders at client organizations.
   

  

 ■ Proactively identify upsell, cross\-sell, and contract renewal opportunities in collaboration with the sales and presales teams.
   

  

 ■ Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs), executive briefings, and customer satisfaction programs (CSAT/NPS).
   

  

 ■ Resolve critical escalations with ownership, empathy, and decisive action.
   

  

* People \& Team Management


 ■ Lead, mentor, and develop a large multi\-disciplinary delivery organization comprising Service Managers, Technical Leads, Engineers, and Support Staff.
   

  

 ■ Build a high\-performance culture centered on accountability, customer centricity, and continuous learning.
   

  

 ■ Drive talent acquisition, succession planning, and retention strategies across the delivery function.
   

  

 ■ Set clear goals, conduct performance reviews, and manage career development plans for direct reports and extended teams.
   

  

 ■ Foster cross\-functional collaboration between delivery, presales, engineering, and commercial Teams.
   

  

* Financial \& Commercial Accountability


 ■ Own the P \& L of the Managed Services delivery function, driving profitability without compromising quality.
   

  

 ■ Manage resource planning, capacity models, and cost optimization across shared delivery pools.
   

  

 ■ Partner with commercial teams on contract negotiations, pricing models, and deal structuring. ■ Track and report on delivery financials including revenue recognition, cost of delivery, and margin performance.
   

  

**Experience Requirements**
 ■ 20\+ years of progressive experience in IT Infrastructure, with a significant portion in managed services or outsourcing environments.
   

  

 ■ Minimum 8–10 years in a senior leadership role managing large\-scale service delivery organizations (200\+ headcount preferred).
   

  

 ■ Proven track record of managing multi\-client managed services portfolios with full P\&L accountability.
   

  

 ■ Hands\-on experience across datacenter, network, systems, cloud, and end\-user domains — not purely managerial.
   

  

 ■ Demonstrated experience in Service Transition — successfully onboarding complex accounts from presales to steady state.
   

  

 ■ Experience managing geographically dispersed teams across onsite, nearshore, and offshore delivery models.
   

  

 ■ Exposure to global/regional enterprise accounts and experience navigating complex client stakeholder environments. ■ Strong familiarity with ITIL framework; ITIL v4 Foundation or Expert certification preferred.
   

  

 ■ Experience with relevant toolsets: ServiceNow, Splunk, SolarWinds, ManageEngine, SCOM, Ansible, or equivalent.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Certifications**
 Educational Background
   

  

 ■ Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field (mandatory).
   

  

 ■ Masters degree / MBA is an advantage, particularly with a technology or operations management focus. Preferred Certifications
   

  

 ■ ITIL v4 Expert or Managing Professional
   

  

 ■ PMP (Project Management Professional) or PRINCE2
   

  

 ■ AWS / Azure / GCP — Architect or Operations level
   

  

 ■ VMware VCP or VCAP
   

  

 ■ Cisco CCNP / CCIE (advantageous)
   

  

 ■ ISO 20000 or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer (advantageous)
   

  

 TECHNICAL DOMAIN EXPERTISE REQUIRED: The candidate must possess deep, hands\-on understanding across the following infrastructure Domains:
   

  

 Domain: Data Center Operations; Key Areas: Physical infrastructure, power \& cooling, colocation management, capacity planning, DCIM
   

  

 Domain: Service Desk \& ITSM; Key Areas: L1/L2/L3 support, ticketing platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy), ITIL processes, SLA governance
   

  

 Domain: End User Computing (EUC); Key Areas: Desktop/laptop lifecycle, VDI/DaaS, O365/M365, Mobile Device Management (MDM), imaging
   

  

 Domain: Network Operations Center (NOC) ; Key Areas: 24x7 monitoring, event management, network performance, SNMP/NMS tools, ITOM
   

  

 Domain: Systems \& Servers; Key Areas: Windows \& Linux administration, Active Directory, patch management, server lifecycle
   

  

 Domain: Networking; Key Areas: LAN/WAN/SD\-WAN, routing \& switching, firewalls, load balancers, network security
   

  

 Domain: Storage \& Backup; Key Areas: SAN/NAS, backup \& recovery, replication, data lifecycle management
   

  

 Domain: Virtualisation; Key Areas: VMware vSphere/vSAN, Hyper\-V, VDI (Horizon, Citrix), containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes)
   

  

 Domain: Cloud Platforms; Key Areas: AWS, Azure, GCP — cloud operations, hybrid cloud management, cloud cost governance, IaaS/PaaS
   

  

 Domain: Shared Services Delivery ; Key Areas: Multi\-client delivery models, shared NOC/SOC, resource pooling, white\-label operations
   

  

 LEADERSHIP \& BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES
   

  

 ■ Executive Presence: Ability to engage and influence C\-suite stakeholders both internally and at client organizations.
   

  

 ■ Strategic Thinking: Balances operational demands with long\-term service strategy and business growth goals.
   

  

 ■ Customer Obsession: Relentless focus on client satisfaction, retention, and experience.
   

  

 ■ People Leadership: Inspires, develops, and holds large teams accountable with fairness and clarity.
   

  

 ■ Decisive Problem Solver: Thrives under pressure; owns escalations and drives swift, effective resolution.
   

  

 ■ Commercial Acumen: Understands the commercial drivers of managed services; thinks in terms of value, margin, and growth.
   

  

 ■ Adaptability: Comfortable operating in fast\-paced, evolving environments with changing client and business needs.
   

  

 ■ Collaborative: Works cross\-functionally with sales, pre\-sales, engineering, and finance to deliver integrated outcomes.
   

  

 Skills: manageengine,scom,splunk,aws,itil,client management,solarwinds,servicenow,ansible,service transition,iso 20000

**Job Description**
 Join our dynamic corporate team and become part of Aman Group. With offices strategically located around the world (Zug, London, Dubai, Singapore, Bangkok, Miami and New York), our corporate colleagues are at the forefront of driving innovation and excellence for our ultra\-luxury brand.
   

  

**Role**
 We are seeking a passionate Senior Accountant to join our team in Dubai. You will support project finance activities, manage budgets and forecasts, ensure accurate financial reporting, and maintain compliance with controls and regulations—playing a key role in driving financial efficiency and project success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage project budgets, ensuring alignment with project plans and contract terms.
* Track and report on project expenditures; identify deviations from the budget.
* Prepare financial forecasts and perform variance analysis comparing budgeted costs to actual costs.
* Analyze financial data to provide insights and recommendations for cost control and optimization.
* Translate project contracts into detailed financial plans; track project performance against these plans.
* Update and maintain project schedules to reflect accurate financial status.
* Monitor project cash flows and manage capital calls as needed.
* Ensure timely payments to contractors and vendors, tracking payment schedules and amounts.
* Review and monitor changes in project agreements; update financial records accordingly.
* Ensure compliance with contract terms related to financial management.
* Prepare regular financial reports for project director and stakeholders; highlight key financial metrics.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, accounting policies, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain accurate and organized financial documentation for audit purposes.
* Collaborate with project director to provide financial insights and support decision\-making.


**Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA, ACCA, or similar certification is required
* Arabic speaking is essential
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience in project development accounting or a similar role
* Strong understanding of project financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management
* Proficiency in accounting software and financial management systems
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities
* Effective communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams


**Benefits**
 At Aman Group, we believe our colleagues are at the core of our success. We offer competitive benefits, including exciting global career opportunities within a rapidly expanding company. We prioritize and support your professional journey, ensuring you feel valued, included, and at home.

 Role Level: Not Applicable Work Type: Full\-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: https://careers.aman.com Job Function: Accounting Company Industry/
   

  

 Sector: Hospitality

**Job Description**
**What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?**
 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

 We are looking for a motivated
 **Graduate Project Manager \- Emirati National** 
 with an academic background in Architecture, Engineering, or Project Management to join our Integrated Design Leadership team within the Property \& Buildings division. This role provides the opportunity to support the delivery of innovative, sustainable, and multidisciplinary design projects from concept through construction.
   

  

 You will work alongside experienced project leaders, gaining exposure to high\-profile projects and developing strong project coordination and delivery skills in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Project Coordination \& Delivery**
* Assist in the planning, organisation, and coordination of large, multidisciplinary design projects.
* Support the tracking of project scope, deliverables, and contractual requirements to ensure accurate execution.
* Assist in preparing project schedules, action logs, and resource plans.
* Help ensure project workflows align with overall programme milestones.


**Team \& Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Coordinate day\-to\-day interactions with engineering and architectural disciplines.
* Facilitate communication by sharing updates, priorities, and actions with internal project teams.
* Support project leads in client and stakeholder communication.
* Assist with coordination between internal teams and relevant authorities to ensure alignment and secure required approvals.


**Quality \& Compliance**
* Support the review of design documentation to ensure quality standards and project requirements are met.
* Help monitor project risks, issues, and progress and report updates to the Project Manager.


**Meetings \& Documentation**
* Participate in internal and external project meetings, contributing to collaborative problem‑solving and decision‑making.
* Assist in preparing project reports, meeting minutes, presentations, and documentation.


**Business Support \& Innovation**
* Support the delivery of the Business Unit (BU) strategy, including sustainability and innovation initiatives.
* Identify potential business development or client engagement opportunities and share them with the team.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies, tools, and best practices in architecture, engineering, and project management.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
* Understanding of integrated design and multidisciplinary project delivery processes.
* Familiarity with design tools and project management software (e.g., Revit, AutoCAD, MS Project).
* Strong organisational and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage tasks effectively, prioritise work, and adapt in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated commitment to quality, sustainability, and continuous improvement.
* Proactive, eager to learn, and comfortable working in a collaborative team setting.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

**Solution Architect** 




**AdTech Platform \-\-\- On\-Premises Build \& Delivery** 




**Start:** 
 Immediate / aligned to project kickoff (Month 1\).
 



 • Location: UAE\-based preferred; hybrid working with on\-site presence required for kickoff, UAT, deployment and handover milestones.
 



 •
 **Working Hours:** 
 Overlapping with UAE business hours (GST / GMT\+4\). • Reporting Line: Programme Director, Platform Delivery.
 



 •
 **Key Collaborators:** 
 Engineering Leads (SSP / DSP / Ad Server / Ops Portal), Product Owner, Ad Operations Lead, Infrastructure Lead, Security Lead, Client Architecture Council.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 The Solution Architect will own the end\-to\-end technical architecture of the platform from blueprint through go live. This is a senior, hands\-on architect role combining deep Ad\-Tech and programmatic domain expertise with strong distributed\-systems design, on\-premises enterprise delivery experience, and the leadership discipline to deliver to plan.
 



 The role partners closely with the Programme Director, Engineering Leads, Product, Ad Operations, Security and Infrastructure teams — and is accountable for translating business intent into a resilient, secure, scalable on\-prem solution that the client team can operate confidently after handover.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 Experience • 12\+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in a Solution / Software Architect role on production systems.
 



 • Demonstrable end\-to\-end ownership of at least one large\-scale Ad\-Tech platform (SSP, DSP, Ad Server or Ad Exchange) from blueprint to production.
 



 • Hands\-on experience delivering systems with stringent latency SLAs (sub\-100ms auction or serving paths) at meaningful scale.
 



 • Proven on\-premises enterprise delivery experience — not exclusively public\-cloud SaaS — including DMZ patterns, hardened deployments and customer\-data\-centre constraints.
 



**Ad\-Tech Domain Depth** 




 • OpenRTB 2\.x specification fluency (request/response, macros, extensions); familiarity with OpenRTB for DOOH desirable.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of RTB auction mechanics, Prebid, Header Bidding, deal\-based selling and PMP.
 



 • Experience integrating with at least two of: Google DV360, The Trade Desk, HiveStack, Criteo, MediaMath, Xandr.
 



 • Familiarity with Proof of Play, viewability, IVT, brand safety and ad\-verification ecosystems.
 



 • Awareness of privacy and aggregated\-demographics handling (no\-PII designs).
 



**Technical Stack** 




 • Languages \& Frameworks: Java \+ Spring Boot, and/or Node.js. Polyglot comfort preferred.
 



 • APIs \& Protocols: REST, gRPC, OpenRTB 2\.x, VAST/VPAID; API\-first design discipline.
 



 • Data \& Streaming: PostgreSQL / TimescaleDB, Apache Kafka, Redis, Elasticsearch; familiarity with data\-lake / event\-store patterns.
 



 • Cloud\-Native \& Infra: Kubernetes (on\-prem expertise essential), Docker, API Gateway (Kong / NGINX), Linux.
 



 • Security: SSO / LDAP, OAuth2 / OIDC, TLS, encryption at rest, RBAC, audit logging.
 



 • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK / OpenSearch, OpenTelemetry.
 



 • Frontend Awareness: Sufficient understanding of React / Angular SPA architectures to govern presentation layer decisions (not hands\-on UI delivery).

Reporting to the Head of Delivery Operations Manager for Dubai, the Senior Project Manager based in Dubai is responsible for the successful delivery of assigned projects, ensuring effective control of scope, schedule, and budget.
   

  

 The role manages all key stakeholder interfaces—both internal and external—throughout the project lifecycle, with a strong emphasis on proactive collaboration and customer engagement. The Senior Project Manager plans, directs, and coordinates project activities to ensure objectives are achieved within the agreed timeline and financial parameters, utilizing approved KONE methodologies, governance frameworks, and tools. The primary focus of the role is to drive high levels of customer satisfaction while safeguarding KONE’s profitability.

* Ensure KONE business success and customer satisfaction with professional stakeholder management
* Accountable for proactively managing customer communication throughout the project.
* Ensure integrated project planning with customers and KONE full\-chain teams
* Managing project deliverables in line with the project plan
* Ensure continuous full\-chain project monitoring and control
* Responsible for successful project start\-up, project reviews, project reporting, and facilitating project governance
* Ensure that project status and progress are effectively communicated to KONE management and the customer
* Responsible for operational and financial project risk identification, mitigation, contingency planning, and potential recovery actions
* Accountable for the project’s financial planning and forecasting, cash flow management, and revenue management
* Responsible for actively driving Sales\-to\-Operations handover quality, accountable for handovers to Customers and Maintenance, as well as project closing activities Maintain master action log and lessons learned document. Ensures sufficient project resourcing and competencies

* Creates and maintains safety and security awareness among project employees and subcontractors. Ensures the following KONE and Customer safety and security policies.


**Are you the one?**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 8 years of experience in project management, preferably within the elevator industry.
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent English \& Arabic communication skills and interpersonal skills.
* Proven track record of successfully managing large\-scale projects from initiation to completion.
* Understanding of the financial aspects of managing projects and product initiatives
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent is highly desirable.


*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co\-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*

data.jd_text:
ChillBase studio is an independent and innovative player in the gaming industry. We’re fueled by our passion for crafting outstanding products.
 



  





 We’re creating
 **OneState** 
 , a mobile life simulator built in Unity. Our art team is facing ambitious challenges as we develop the project with a realistic approach and high standards for visual quality and technical solutions. We use modern technologies and tools, continuously refining our pipelines and aiming for the highest level of quality and immersion.
 



  





 If you are seeking to be a part of an engaged team, work on captivating projects with minimal bureaucracy, and receive regular, constructive feedback, then you’ll find your place with us.
 



  





**Expectations** 




  





**What we want to see** 



* Experience as an Art Director or Head of Art on game projects
* Strong expertise in mobile AAA realism
* Deep understanding of mobile platform limitations and how to work within them
* Experience building art systems, standards, and processes
* Experience collaborating with producers and directors as partners
* Strong skills in presenting and defending creative decisions
* Cross platform experience with mobile, PC, or console projects is a strong plus
* Strategic mindset
* High level of ownership and responsibility
* Strong communication skills
* Focus on results and business value
* Willingness to work in a partnership model rather than manual micromanagement



  





**What you will be doing** 



* Shaping and evolving the project’s art strategy together with the CCO
* Building an autonomous art structure including roles, ownership, standards, and processes
* Ensuring AAA level quality and visual consistency across the product
* Making key visual decisions and defending them at the producer and director level
* Developing head level roles and growing strong leaders within the art team
* Managing the balance between quality, timelines, cost, and value
* Growing the art direction as a driver of product and IP growth



  





**Benefits** 




  





**Growth and development** 




 Our project is actively growing, as well as the team that creates it. We invest in the growth of each specialist and regularly review salaries based on performance. Moreover, we have a promotion system that allows specialists to showcase their talents in more responsible positions.
 



  





**Comfortable conditions** 




 You can choose various work types: hybrid or office. Also we have flexible hours with the option of taking days off.
 



  





**Care for employees** 




 We offer sick days without salary loss, assistance in difficult life situations, no bureaucratic nightmares and processes for the sake of processes.

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 At Dyson, we’re driven by a relentless pursuit of innovation—pushing boundaries in engineering, AI, and robotics. Our new Data Intelligence team sits at the heart of this mission: shaping Dyson’s future through data. Here, we blend creativity, precision, and audacity to power intelligent products. We craft data strategies and pipelines that fuel the next generation of connected devices.
   

  

 You’ll work alongside brilliant minds from Dyson global engineering team and external software/hardware partners in an environment built for exploration, discovery, delivery and impact.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Lead Data Intelligence Project Manager, you ensure that every project has the resources it needs to take off, you'll orchestrate data operations that power product development across Dyson’s global teams. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Act as the primary liaison between our external project teams and our internal technical departments (Data Curation and MLOps). You will own the "data logistics" for the entire project lifecycle—from initial storage setup to final delivery of high\-quality training sets.
* You will be the strategic lead for our labelling workforce, managing the balance between our in\-house contractors and 3rd party service providers to ensure we never hit a capacity bottleneck.
* Overseeing data storage setup and maintenance to guarantee security, accessibility, and compliance.
* Maintaining rigorous documentation and workflows that ensure project transparency and repeatability.
* Supporting cross\-functional communication between data teams, contractors, and engineering partners.


**About you**
* 8\+ years in Project or Program Management, with at least 2 years specifically in AI/ML Data Operations or Data Management. You’ve delivered complex projects on time and within scope—often in fast\-changing settings.
* Demonstrated success in managing 3rd party vendors or service providers, including contract negotiation, quality assurance, issue resolution, and ongoing relationship management.
* Machine Learning Lifecycle Knowledge: Strong understanding of how data flows from collection → cleaning → labeling → training → deployment.
* Tooling Familiarity: Experience with labeling platforms (Labelbox, CVAT, Label Studio) and project management tools (Jira, Asana, or Airtable).
* Data Literacy: Basic understanding of data storage architectures (S3, SQL, Snowflake) and data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA).
* Communication: Exceptional "translation" skills—the ability to explain technical MLOps constraints to business stakeholders and vice versa.
* A solid understanding of modern data storage solutions (cloud, on\-premises, hybrid), including principles of data security, privacy, access control, and regulatory compliance.
* Able to translate complex technical requirements into clear actions for both technical and non\-technical audiences. You’re adept at influencing and building consensus.
* Confident interfacing with cross\-functional teams—coordinating with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and external stakeholders to deliver smooth handovers and alignment.
* Well\-versed in project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall). Known for driving continuous improvement, clear documentation, and repeatable processes.
* Thorough, highly organized, and relentless in troubleshooting issues and removing blockers before they impact delivery.
* Proactive, accountable, and comfortable juggling competing priorities. You always keep end goals in focus and balance urgency with quality.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Data Engineering, Engineering, or Information Technology); higher degree or PMP/Prince2 certification is a plus.


 Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

**About the Role:** 




 The Head of QA is the enterprise quality authority, responsible for transforming RAKBANK’s approach to software quality into a modern, automation\-first, AI\-driven quality engineering function.
 



  





 This role will lead the shift from manual, end\-of\-cycle testing to continuous, embedded quality across the full software development lifecycle. Working closely with Digital, Engineering, and Platform teams, the role ensures all releases meet the robustness and compliance standards required in a regulated banking environment.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing:** 



* Define and drive the enterprise QA strategy, including automation\-first and AI\-assisted testing adoption
* Establish and lead a Quality Engineering Centre of Excellence, standardising tools, frameworks, and best practices
* Embed quality across the SDLC through shift\-left practices, CI/CD quality gates, and squad\-level ownership
* Own test automation strategy across UI, API, and data layers; track coverage and ROI
* Implement AI\-driven testing (e.g., self\-healing automation, intelligent test prioritisation, defect triage)
* Lead non\-functional testing (performance, resilience, security, and API contract testing)
* Govern test environments and test data management, including synthetic data and data masking
* Oversee UAT governance and own release quality sign\-off (go/no\-go decisions)
* Define and report QA metrics (defect leakage, automation coverage, cycle time, incident rates)
* Build and lead the QA function, including capability development and team structure



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* 12\+ years of experience in software quality engineering
* 5\+ years in a senior QA leadership role (Head / Director level)
* Experience in banking, fintech, or regulated financial services environments
* Proven track record of leading QA transformation from manual to automation\-led environments
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, and CI/CD\-integrated quality practices
* Exposure to AI\-driven testing and emerging QA technologies
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or similar
* ISTQB Advanced Test Manager certification (preferred: Expert level or equivalent)



  





**Skills:** 



* QA strategy and transformation leadership
* Automation frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, etc.)
* CI/CD integration and quality gate governance
* Performance testing and resilience engineering (JMeter, Gatling, k6\)
* Test data management (synthetic data, PII masking, governance)
* AI\-driven testing tools and practices
* Stakeholder management and executive reporting
* Team leadership, mentoring, and capability building



  





**What You’ll Gain:** 



* Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives
* Medical coverage for you and your family
* Comprehensive life insurance
* Exposure to high\-impact strategic projects
* Supportive and inclusive workplace culture
* Opportunities for career advancement and professional development

data.jd_text:
**Head of Category \& Merchandising** 




  





 About the Role
 



  





 Fynde has partnered with a global cross\-border eCommerce platform that specialises in bringing international products to customers across the Middle East and wider international markets. With a strong presence across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, the business simplifies access to millions of global products by managing sourcing, import logistics, and last\-mile delivery through a seamless, consumer\-first digital experience.
 



  





 We are now headhunting a Head of Category \& Merchandising to take strategic and commercial ownership of category performance across the platform, with an initial focus on Health \& Supplements alongside broader involvement across multiple product categories within the organisation.
 



  





 Based in Dubai, this is a commercially driven leadership role focused on category growth, merchandising strategy, localisation, digital trading performance, and customer engagement across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and wider international markets. The position blends category management, product selection, pricing, ecommerce merchandising, analytics, and AI\-enabled optimisation, requiring someone capable of shaping both strategic direction and operational execution within a fast\-paced cross\-border ecommerce environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Category \& Commercial Ownership** 




 Lead the strategy, development, and ongoing performance management of key product categories across the platform, with a particular focus on Health \& Supplements. Drive revenue growth, margin optimisation, customer engagement, and category expansion in alignment with wider business objectives across multiple international markets.
 



  





**Assortment Development \& Curation** 




 Build commercially relevant and scalable product assortments based on customer behaviour, market trends, data analysis, and commercial opportunity. Continuously identify opportunities to strengthen category depth, introduce new products, and optimise the product mix across both regional and international audiences.
 



  





**Product Performance \& Trading Analysis** 




 Use dashboards, sales reporting, customer insights, and trading data to evaluate category performance and identify opportunities for optimisation. Analyse SKU performance, pricing effectiveness, conversion trends, promotional impact, and customer demand to drive commercial decision\-making.
 



  





**Pricing \& Promotional Strategy** 




 Develop and optimise pricing strategies in line with consumer expectations, competitive positioning, and margin objectives. Plan and execute promotional activity to support seasonal campaigns, category growth initiatives, and overall trading performance.
 



  





**Regional \& International Localisation** 




 Support the localisation and optimisation of category content, product presentation, and customer experience across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and wider international markets. Ensure merchandising strategies align with local consumer behaviours, cultural nuances, and evolving market expectations.
 



  





**AI \& Merchandising Automation** 




 Partner with data and technology teams to leverage AI, automation, and merchandising tools to improve category performance. Contribute towards initiatives involving product recommendations, dynamic pricing, search optimisation, inventory visibility, and broader ecommerce automation strategies.
 



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 Work closely with marketing, operations, supply chain, customer experience, and technology teams to ensure strong execution of category plans and alignment across all customer touchpoints.
 



  





**Market Intelligence \& Competitor Benchmarking** 




 Monitor developments across ecommerce, health \& wellness, consumer behaviour, and digital merchandising trends. Benchmark competitor activity, assortment strategy, pricing structures, and promotional campaigns to identify commercial opportunities and areas for improvement.
 



  





**Lifecycle \& Inventory Management** 




 Oversee the full lifecycle management of SKUs, ensuring products remain commercially viable, available, and aligned with category strategy. Collaborate with supply chain and operations teams to support forecasting, replenishment, and inventory optimisation.
 



 Requirements
 



  




* 5\+ years of experience within ecommerce category management, digital merchandising, ecommerce trading, or related commercial functions.
* Strong experience within Health, Supplements, Wellness, FMCG, Consumer Goods, or adjacent ecommerce\-led categories.
* Proven commercial acumen with responsibility for revenue growth, margin optimisation, product mix, and trading performance.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making capabilities with experience interpreting large datasets and translating insight into commercial action.
* Experience working alongside AI\-enabled merchandising tools, pricing engines, ecommerce CMS platforms, or automation technologies.
* Understanding of cross\-border ecommerce operations, digital marketplaces, and international trading environments.
* Experience operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, or wider Middle Eastern markets would be highly advantageous.
* Arabic language capabilities would be highly advantageous.
* Entrepreneurial, proactive, and commercially minded approach, with the ability to build, shape, and improve processes within a growing organisation.
* Ability to operate both strategically and hands\-on within a fast\-moving ecommerce environment.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 Fleet Technical Management at Emirates comprises five specialized teams dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of service and reliability for our fleet.
   

  

**Airframe Systems:** 
 Handles mechanical systems including flight controls, landing gear, and air conditioning.
   

  

**Structures** 
 : Supports aircraft structures, including repairs and modifications for metallic and composite parts.
   

  

**Avionics** 
 : Manages avionics systems, including navigation, communications, and advanced IFE systems.
   

  

**Powerplant** 
 : Oversees engines and APUs, focusing on health monitoring and optimization.
   

  

**Cabin** 
 : Maintains passenger cabins, flight decks, and retrofits, ensuring top\-notch comfort and functionality.
   

  

 Each team ensures our fleet operates efficiently and safely, meeting all technical and service standards.
   

  

 As a Technical Services Engineer I \- Cabin Upgrades and Reconfigurations (Inflight Entertainment and Connectivity) you will provide fleet technical management, continuing airworthiness management and technical support functions for Emirates fleet to ensure compliance to regulatory \& safety requirements, reliability, passenger comfort and cost effectiveness.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Provide fleet technical management, continuing airworthiness management and technical support functions for Cabin Interior.
* Routinely evaluate manufacturers/regulatory authorities’ technical documents, taking appropriate actions and update internal engineering documents including Engineering Order and Special Engineering Workcard.
* Review in\-service data (e.g Tech log, Pilot Reports, Defects) and implement actions to improve fleet, engine, component and/or system reliability and maintainability, including optimisation of aircraft maintenance programs.
* Deliver technical assistance and operational support in disruptions scenarios including the handling of technical/AOG, troubleshooting, aircraft chronic and deferred defects and technical delays.
* Carry out Emirates Engineering design organisational activities such as but not limited to development of standard operating procedures, in house repairs, use of alternate parts, deviations from manufacturing documents by exercising Design Engineer (DE) privileges of Part 21 Design Organisation as appointed by Head of Design (HOD).
* Provide support and expertise for acquisition of new Aircraft and end of lease activities
* Act as a technical liaison with Aircraft, Engines and/or Component Manufacturers and internal stakeholders (e.g flight operations, service delivery) to address fleet significant faults, defects, design issues and quality escapements.
* Provide technical clarifications/justification to internal stakeholders in support of cost optimisation, contract negotiation, repair and modification processes.
* Carry out project management functions such as but not limited to major modifications, retrofits, cabin reconfigurations and aircraft phaseout requirements including preparation of cost benefit studies or budget requirements on changes/repairs with recommendations/proposals for approval by management.
* Review and analyse technical data in support of department KPIs, highlighting trends and making recommendation reports/proposal for improvement.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree or Honours (12\+3 or equivalent).
* More than 10 years of experience in Engineering, Aeronautical.

* Related Aircraft Engineering experience.
* Should have a minimum of 8 years in Technical Services function of which at least 5 years of experience pertaining to Emirates fleet type/aircraft systems.
* Knowledge of latest technical developments and industry trends on respective systems.
* Ability to analyse and synthesise technical information for implementation in cost effective ways.
* Excellent drafting/report writing skills.
* Demonstrable experience in managing complex tasks and decision making in a fast\-paced environment.


 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Principal Mechanical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data center projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in mechanical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre mechanical systems, including chilled water plant design (chillers, pumps, distribution systems), air handling and distribution (CRAH/CRAC units, ducting, containment strategies), high\-density cooling solutions (direct liquid cooling, rear\-door heat exchangers), fire suppression systems (clean agent, water\-based), and energy\-efficient HVAC design incorporating economizers and free cooling strategies
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, thermal modelling, pipe sizing, hydraulic calculations, and system balancing for mission\-critical environments
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards including ASHRAE (90\.1, TC 9\.9\), NFPA codes, and energy efficiency metrics (PUE, DCiE)
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**Responsibilities**
* Lead mechanical systems design for data centre and mission\-critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including cooling infrastructure (air\-cooled, liquid\-cooled, hybrid systems), HVAC, fire suppression, and plumbing systems
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data centre owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement

data.jd_text:
**About Keyrock**
 Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change\-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
   

  

 Today, we rock with over 180 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels and Singapore, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
   

  

 We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well\-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high\-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.
   

  

 But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. We support the growth of Web3 startups through our Accelerator Program. We upgrade ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
   

  

 At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.
   

  

**Mission statement**
 The
 **Tech Lead** 
 plays a pivotal role in bridging
 **business objectives** 
 with
 **technical execution** 
 . This role is not purely managerial nor solely individual contributor, but a
 **hybrid position** 
 that combines
 **hands\-on engineering** 
 ,
 **architectural leadership** 
 , and
 **team enablement** 
 . A Tech Lead ensures delivery excellence by actively contributing to the codebase, guiding the team technically, and aligning execution with long\-term strategic goals.
   

  

 At Keyrock, the
 **Tech Lead** 
 is a
 **senior technical contributor** 
 who drives the
 **implementation and delivery** 
 of engineering initiatives within their Business Unit. The Tech Lead is accountable for
 **technical execution and delivery quality**

 While the
 **Head of Engineering (HoE)** 
 focuses on
 **strategic alignment \-** 
 ensuring that engineering outcomes meet the broader objectives agreed with the
 **Head of Product (HoP) \-** 
 the Tech Lead operates as the

**Job Description**
* Act as the technical point of accountability for the Service Market Making Business Unit.
* Balance strategic thinking with pragmatic delivery, ensuring systems are built to last while meeting immediate needs.
* Champion collaboration across teams, ensuring alignment between product, design, QA, and engineering.
* Inspire and develop engineers through mentorship, coaching, and technical guidance, fostering growth and autonomy within the team.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Drive Delivery and Alignment: Partner with the Head of Engineering to own delivery of entire work\-streams, ensuring architecture and engineering decisions align with both immediate requirements and business strategy.
