* Technical Leadership: Guide system design, ensure scalability and resilience, and optimise performance across applications and infrastructure.
* Maintain Standards: Uphold engineering best practices, enforce coding guidelines, and partner with QA to embed automation and validation in the delivery pipeline.
* Codebase Health: Manage technical debt, lead refactoring initiatives, and ensure long\-term maintainability and operational excellence.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to define scope, refine requirements, and plan delivery in a transparent and predictable manner.

* 5\+ years in a Technical Leadership position guiding teams, shaping architecture, and driving delivery of complex projects
* Demonstrated expertise in architecting and maintaining high\-concurrency, low\-latency trading systems at scale
* Advanced proficiency in Rust; working knowledge of Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript) and Python is an advantage
* Deep experience with data\-intensive architectures and real\-time data pipelines
* Proven track record deploying, optimising and operating AWS environments for ultra\-low\-latency workloads
* Hands\-on experience containerising applications and managing Kubernetes clusters in production
* Familiarity with GitOps workflows to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration and deployments
* Solid command of software engineering best practices, including Agile methodologies, DevOps principles and end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines
* Knowledge of DevSecFinOps principles to embed security, compliance and cost\-governance throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Demonstrated leadership of engineering teams, with a commitment to fostering collaboration, mentorship and continuous professional growth
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills, able to partner effectively with Product, Architecture, Quantitative Research and Operations
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, with a passion for building scalable, reliable and secure systems
* Deep domain knowledge of finance and trading, particularly within the cryptocurrency sector
* Experience in fast\-paced, dynamic financial or fintech environments is highly desirable


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.
   

  

 Soft Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Ownership \& Reliability – Take full responsibility for your work. Deliver high\-quality service, meet deadlines, and follow through on commitments. Anticipate and proactively address potential issues before they arise.
* Initiative \& Problem\-Solving – Approach challenges with a problem\-solving entrepreneurial mindset. Make sound, independent judgments and take the initiative to drive solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
* Operational Diligence – Respond strategically to technical and operational challenges, ensuring robust and reliable trading infrastructure while instilling confidence in the team’s processes.
* Curiosity \& Growth Mindset – Continuously seek to improve your technical skills and knowledge. Stay ahead of industry trends and take the initiative to practice and explore new technologies that excite you.

data.jd_text:
**JOB TITLE**
 Senior Brand Manager, Rare Disease, Neurology, Gulf
   

  

**About Astrazeneca**
 AstraZeneca is a global, science\-led, patient\-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialisation of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 AstraZeneca is accelerating the expansion of our geographical footprint in rare diseases following the acquisition of Alexion in 2021\. Rare diseases are a high\-growth therapy area with rapid innovation and significant unmet medical need. Over 7,000 rare diseases are known today – yet less than 1% of them have an approved treatment.
   

  

 As we are currently positioned as a Rare Disease leader, we seek a Rare Diseases Senior Brand Manager to join our Commercial Team in UAE. The Senior Brand Manager is a full\-time position, responsible for developing and implementing rare disease brand strategies for Gulf Markets.
   

  

 The selected candidate will work very closely with the Gulf Franchise Head to deploy and adapt the AZ brand strategy to the local market, including tactics and execution.
   

  

 The role reports to the Franchise Head.
   

  

 The Senior Brand Manager will develop strategy for assigned portfolio: brand planning process, brand positioning in context of competitive landscape (messages, programs, key initiatives).
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Develops and coordinates implementation of marketing programs for assigned brand(s)including cost management
* Ensure launch readiness and planning of key activities pre/post launch. Builds solid marketing mix through delivery of appropriate channels. Proposes and supports design of appropriate programs to deliver excellence in customer experience
* Develop robust understanding of the patient journey to design tailored programs tackling the gaps within, with special attention to patient finding activities
* Leads forecast during the business planning process. Input to market research plan and monitors KPIs for brand dashboard
* Contributes for development and implementation of KOL management plan
* Lead identification and development of marketing best practices and support implementation on the local market
* Demonstrates business ethics and ensure active respect of values, business ethics, local laws, policies and Marketing procedures. Ensures all activities and responsibilities are carried out in compliance with the high standards of ethics and integrity required by the Code of Conduct, supporting Policies and Standards and Company Values to protect and enhance long term performance and reputation
* Manage advertising and other support agencies in implementing global communication tools and in developing local marketing materials, including promotional materials for the field team.
* Establish and maintain quality and trustful contacts within the relevant medical community, with opinion leaders, influencers and deciders, in compliance with local requirements: have frequent contact with field team, HCP and KOLs
* Support field teams’ execution of promotional events from concept design to content delivery
* Other duties within position’s scope, as assigned by Line Manager


**Essential For The Role**
* Science degree and or master’s degree in a scientific discipline
* Minimum 8 years of pharmaceutical experience
* Minimum 5 Years of Marketing Experience in Specialty Brands.
* Proven new product launch experience, including launch readiness and leading the cross\-functional team (CFT) from 12 months pre\-launch through post launch
* Experience in shaping ecosystem for diagnosis \& management of complex disorders.
* Availability for travel within Gulf Markets
* Resilience to work effectively in a fast\-changing environment
* Able to act and influence at a senior level
* Evidence of excellent skills in communication, presentation, influencing and projects tactical management


**Desirable for the role**
* Previous Haematology /or Nephrology/ or Neurology/ or Rare Endocrine marketing experience is a plus
* Rare disease experience.
* Experience in niche markets/orphan drugs.
* Experience in Gulf markets is other than UAE
* Solid leadership profile, potential to develop in a more senior role
* Excellent KEE management

An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

* Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
* Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available, and we hope it’s yours.

 Follow AstraZeneca on Facebook
   

  

 Follow AstraZeneca on Instagram

**Job Purpose** 



* To support the Bank’s business strategy by acquiring and managing high\-net\-worth (HNW) clients. The role requires a UAE National Relationship Manager with a strong background in wealth management, capable of delivering tailored financial solutions, enhancing client relationships, and contributing to the growth of the Bank’s HNW client base.
* The role is required to acquire/ transfer HNW clients’ portfolios to Emirates Investment Bank to generate fee income and Assets Under Management (AUM).
* The role must work closely with team leaders, Head of Business Development and Investment Advisors to ensure client product suitability is maintained as per the internal policies.



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**Client Acquisition and Revenue:** 



* To source new qualified clients for Wealth Management business based on the business plan submitted at the time of on\-boarding.
* To ensure generation of net fee income through the sale of Investment products and to generate the required Assets under Management (AUM).
* To maintain regular contact with the client including regular face\-to\-face meetings and maintain call reports of all client activities.
* To profile the clients’ risk and return aspirations and work with Investment Advisors to maintain client risk profile suitability at all times.
* To increase assets under management of existing clients and develop the relationship.
* To provide and maintain, on an ongoing basis, a monthly report, figures, forecasting and any other records which may be required by the Team Leader to keep up\-to\-date records of sales \& performance.
* To do account planning with Team Leader and Head of Distribution and Investment Advisors to understand the needs of the client and provide appropriate financial solutions to the client.
* To ensure consistent service delivery is maintained at all touch points for clients.
* To continuously provide feedback on competitive activities to the Product and Business team to track market developments.
* To attend regular product trainings and to be updated with the financial market developments.
* To safeguard the Bank’s reputation by ensuring ethical and professional behavior is maintained at all times.
* To maintain superior client service levels by pro\-actively meeting the clients on regular basis and pre\-empting any possible client complaints and concerns.



  





**Client Portfolio Management:** 



* To maintain and enhance new and existing relationships with key and prospective clients to ensure business continuity and growth.
* To provide regular updates to the Head of Business Development/ Wealth Management on performance of the portfolio accounts and on key market updates which may impact client attrition.
* To analyse the client’s financial standing to assess the credit risk for the client and ensure that the credit quality of the portfolio is not compromised.
* To recommend/reject or approve credit facilities, within prescribed limits, after a comprehensive analysis of the client’s net worth and proposed financial standing.
* To ensure provision of high quality and timely service to clients.



**Internal Collaboration:** 



* To monitor service level agreements and manage the coordination with other departments to meet client service expectations.
* To engage with key stakeholders including on\-boarding team, credit, operations, technology, and treasury to deliver a timely and effective level of client experience.



**Regulatory and Compliance:** 



* To ensure that the client being on\-boarded is of good reputation and financial standing and will maintain proper financial and KYC documentation at all times.
* To ensure customer documentation is complete and in line with the Bank’s requirements.
* To help service coordinators in resolving documentation and other client\-related discrepancies.
* To adhere to a robust control framework, ensuring communications with clients meet internal control standards and external regulatory requirements.
* To ensure clients’ KYC and risk profile are reviewed regularly as per compliance policy, and is updated with any new changes in clients’ financial status.
* To ensure risk assessment of the client portfolio is maintained by personally reviewing all proposals, identifying, and assessing all risk inherent in credit exposures.
* To ensure all compliance/ credit and AML queries are answered within 48 hours.
* To ensure all internal and external trainings are attended and CPD hours are completed.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Overall, 10\-15years of experience in Banking and minimum 5\-10 years of experience in Wealth Management/ Private Banking/ Asset Management.
* Proficient in MS Office.
* CISI qualification

 We are looking for an experienced teacher/leader with a passion for this subject area. Proficient and experienced in teaching Design and Technology, ideally with experience of teaching across GCSE/iGCSE and A Level/BTEC.
   

  

***Enough For All, For Ever***
 The Arbor School opened in 2018 with a very different vision of what education could and should be – experiential, authentic and inspired by the natural beauty, human ingenuity, and profound ecological and social challenges of the Arabian Peninsula.
   

  

 The cultivation of a learning community uniquely committed to understanding and restoring the health of ecological and human communities as interconnected parts of a whole requires equal parts optimism, ambition, and humility. A fundamental belief in the inherit goodness of people and their capacity to act with empathy and compassion underscores the sense of hope that is fundamental to learning for a sustainable future. The resilience and determination to tackle challenges that have grown to global proportion is essential to finding sustainable solutions and orchestrating the social changes needed to grow them to scale. The realisation that comes from recognising that we are all students – never a master – drives our commitment to ignite a lifelong love of learning.
   

  

**Role**
 Recognising the interconnected nature of the cognitive, affective, and participative domains, and their roles in shaping learning, we are pursuing a holistic approach to teaching and learning, designed to prepare learners:
   

  

* to understand the interconnected concepts of sustainability, individual and collective well\-being, and environmental and social justice;
* to find purpose, meaning and joy in their interactions with the natural world and with each other, and to seek to understand people who are different to themselves;
* to experience a sense of accomplishment and self\-efficacy through their actions at home, in school and in the wider world.


  

  

**The Arbor Promise**
 Arbor teachers are a part of a community which is inclusive, fun\-loving, and active. Arbor teachers enjoy authentic friendships with their colleagues, positive relationships with school leaders, who care for their wellbeing, and are a team in the true sense. Arbor teachers are resilient in the face of challenge, are stable and calm in the face of change, and creative and flexible when solving problems. Arbor teachers bring their passions and interests to enrich our school and are clear that there is an expectation to do so. We commit to meeting agreed deadlines, to communicating proactively with an assumption of positive intent and share a passion to provide an education of the highest quality to our students.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The successful candidate will be proficient and experienced in teaching Design and Technology with experience of teaching across GCSE/iGCSE and A Level/BTEC. You will lead the team, with responsibilities across KS3, KS4, and KS5, overseeing Design Technology.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Doing all that you can to ensure that you safeguard and promote the welfare of students (in line with Arbor’s Safeguarding framework/policy/Code of Conduct).
* Positively and actively promoting the Arbor vision, mission, and values.
* Ensuring your practice is in line with the Arbor Staff Handbook, the Arbor Support Teacher: A Framework for Outstanding Support.
* Implementing, where appropriate, school policies, procedures and expected practices, as identified by the Senior Leadership Team at the Arbor School.
* Undertake specific operational tasks as agreed upon with the Assistant Head of Curriculum, including some or all of the following areas:
* To support in developing and reviewing the Design Technology curriculum and schemes of work at KS3, KS4 and KS5\.
* Support in the preparation, delivery and evaluation of schemes of work for the school in accordance with the National Curriculum requirements; with a particular focus on challenge, pace, high order questioning and thinking skills to facilitate students accessing the highest grades at KS3, KS4 and KS5\.
* To ensure that the learning environment is well\-ordered, safe and stimulating, leading by example to encourage a high standard of display work in classrooms and communal areas with a clear emphasis on celebrating success, sharing achievements and highlighting specialist subject knowledge.


**Required Candidate Profile**
* Native\-level English language skills
* Bachelor’s degree in Design Technology or similar, with a PGCE in Education with QTS or equivalent
* A minimum of 3 years experience teaching Design and Technology in the UK or a reputable British school overseas
* A track record of outstanding GSCE and/or A Level examination results.
* A track record of outstanding teaching and learning and an ability to create a caring and nurturing classroom environment.


**Remuneration:** 
 A competitive tax\-free compensation package will be provided in accordance with School's policy and UAE labour law regulations.
   

  

**Application:** 
 To apply for this position, please complete the application on TES and upload:
   

  

* An up\-to\-date CV with a recent photograph to be included.
* A letter of application, no longer than two pages in length, which outlines your educational philosophy and suitability for the Arbor School.


***The Arbor School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all the students in our care and expects all applicants to share this commitment. We hold ourselves to a high standard of effective, safer recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All appointments are subject to CV and qualification checks, interview, identity checks, criminal record checks, and successful references.***
***All appointments are subject to the approval of the Knowledge and Human Development Authority and the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation.***

data.jd_text:
Seddiqi Holding is a family\-owned and managed company with a unique, diversified portfolio of businesses and brands across numerous sectors. The business units include Ahmed Seddiqi – the longest standing and largest unit within the group, Seddiqi Properties, Swiss Watch Services and Mizzen.
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **Facility Manager** 
 who will oversee and manage all aspects of facility management as well as maintenance, security, and services for commercial and residential facilities. The primary objective is to ensure that these facilities meet the needs of employees, organizations, or residents. The Facilities Manager would also be responsible for overseeing various services that facilitate the seamless performance of businesses and organizations. This includes tasks such as cleaning, security, parking, and building maintenance, including heating and air conditioning. The main responsibility will be to ensure that buildings are safe, compliant with local Statutory regulations, and fully operational, thus enabling the effective functioning of all structures providing tenants with an efficient and secure working or living environment by applying best business practices to effectively manage resources, services, processes, and policies.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Develop and implement the Building Engineering Operations Plan \& FM operations plan for each property in coordination with the Head of Department.
* Identify the unique requirements of each property and ensure that the plan addresses them effectively and establish relevant Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with the Facility Management service provider based on the building engineering operations plan.
* Conduct monthly KPI compliance sessions with the contractors to evaluate performance. Ensure delivery schedules, quantity and quality criteria are met and submit reports on completed work by contractors and vendors
* Work with the HOD to prepare budgets specific to each property. Understand capex requirement based on Life cycle analysis of the commissioned assets in the property.
* Prepare and present business cases to senior management with optimal financial analysis and total life cycle calculations.
* Develop short term, medium term and long\-term plans for building improvements, refurbishment, major renovations, and capital assets replacement
* Develop processes designed to promote effectiveness, efficiency, and cost optimization initiatives for all buildings.
* Assist HOD with the implementation of CAFM Software.
* Working effectively with all departments and staff members to resolve issues, handle requests, queries, and complaints, escalating to the Head of department as required.
* Update and monitor compliance with relevant FM policies and procedures as well as compliance with the relevant department Delegation of Authority Matrix.
* Manage filed inspections and monitor the documentation related to the audits being conducted on Service providers to ensure that services are being conducted in accordance with agreed specifications and that customers are being served with the highest quality FM standards, and take the necessary actions upon the detection of poor performance
* Ensure that building/ property is compliant with each specific statutory regulations enforced by the local authorities.
* Set up, monitor and track teams related KPI’s, monitors performance against plan and initiates remedial actions in case of discrepancy between actual and expected performance.
* Prepare and track facility budget and submit monthly reports including the tracking of expenses and payments issues according to budget allocations and ensure expense targets as per KPIs are achieved.
* Develop and implement cost optimization initiatives for all buildings in coordination with engineers and supervisors.
* Identifies opportunities to improve current delivery model to enhance efficiency of facilities.
* Keeps accurate and up\-to\-date financial and operational records and prepare monthly /quarterly operational and financial reports in coordination with HOD, for management review and ensure they are completed accurately and submitted on time.
* Promotes a Customer Centric approach by introducing various activities and programs such as training of the team, surveys to set quality assurance measures and allow for continuous improvement
* Examine all the PPM schedule, PPM Task sheet \& Check lists and make changes wherever applicable.
* Ensure that maintenance is undertaken in accordance with agreed specifications \& as per the O\&M manual.
* Act as Project Manager overseeing the bidding and implementation of IFM tenders, major renovation, and capital improvement projects on the properties.
* Ensure that Air quality, water quality \& other Health/ Safety parameters are within the specified limits by the local authorities.
* Ensure that the team of Engineers \& Supervisors complete their monthly audit at each facility \& submit report.
* Ensures that all relevant statutory and regulatory requirements relating to facilities management are met as per local laws and regulations.
* Ensuring that periodic meetings are scheduled and held with service providers to review operational activities, non\-conformance, etc.
* Raise environmental awareness at the properties by recommending and implementing effective sustainable strategies to help lessen our impact on the environment and achieve economic benefits.
* Provides guidance, support, and leadership to team to ensure effective and efficient flow of work in coordination with Senior Manager/HOD.
* Provides advice on technical, facility, maintenance and safety matters and ensures the sites are safe by adhering to relevant safety rules, legislation, and best practice.



  





 In order to be successful in this role, you should have:
 



  




* An ideal Candidate should hold 10 years of experience in Facility Management.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Engineering or Diploma in Engineering.
* Ability to identify issues and determine repairs that are needed.
* Good knowledge of budgeting and resource allocation.



  





 If you are ready for your next challenge, Apply Now!

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Drive hands\-on project management activities including project planning, tracking, governance, stakeholder coordination, RAID management, reporting, and delivery follow\-ups
* Support the Enterprise PMO in managing project portfolios, governance frameworks, reporting standards, stage\-gate controls, and delivery oversight across multiple initiatives
* Manage integrated project plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, actions, and timelines across concurrent transformation programmes

* Build strong working relationships across stakeholders while maintaining a highly collaborative, service\-oriented, and delivery\-focused approach
* Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on PMO maturity, governance quality, reporting accuracy, and operational effectiveness



  





**Knowledge, skills \& experience:** 



* 7–10 years of experience in project management, PMO, enterprise transformation, or programme delivery roles within complex organisations
* Strong hands\-on project delivery experience with the ability to independently manage multiple moving projects and stakeholders simultaneously
* Experience working within Enterprise PMO environments supporting governance, portfolio management, reporting, and transformation delivery
* Strong understanding of project governance, RAID management, executive reporting, milestone tracking, and cross\-functional coordination
* Experience supporting enterprise transformation, operational excellence, shared services, or large\-scale business transformation initiatives
* Ability to work in fast\-paced, high\-volume environments with strong attention to detail and ownership of deliverables
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work closely with senior leadership, business teams, operational stakeholders, and support functions
* Practical and hands\-on approach with strong follow\-through, coordination, and problem\-solving capabilities
* Experience working on enterprise systems and transformation initiatives involving ERP platforms, automation, workflow tools, or digital transformation programmes is preferred
* Proficiency with MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Power BI, or similar PMO and reporting tools
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, MSP, or equivalent project management certifications are preferred



  





**Availability** 
 : Preference will be given to candidates available immediately.
 



  





 We are looking for a candidate who will be able to work in United Arab Emirates. Please apply with your resume and remember to provide us with your contact details.
 



  





 We will review your job application within 7 working days. Should your profile fit the requirements of the role a consultant from Edari will be in touch with you to get a deeper understanding of your profile, to discuss the role in more detail and potential next steps.

data.jd_text:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.
   

  

 Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross\-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
   

  

 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
   

  

 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.
   

  

 For our business, for clients, and for you
   

  

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.
   

  

**Technical Tasks:**
* Oversee and lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the fund accounting service for close\-ended funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance with fund governing documents and regulatory guidance.
* Provide leadership on complex client and operational matters requiring senior judgment.
* Ensure full adherence to the prevailing control environment.
* Be a leading participant in the continuous development of our operating processes and procedures.
* Be an escalation point for technical queries from all stakeholders in your region.
* Oversee the timely completion of all audits.
* Ensure local teams’ adherence to regulatory compliance and underlying reporting.


**Tasks/Responsibilities:**
* Translate strategy into an operational plan for delivery of service and provide guidance to ensure consistent organisational leadership and day\-to\-day business running.
* Ensure effective implementation of the operating model with ownership for both onshore and offshore components, work closely with other regional functional leads across operations and wider CRM and Product teams.
* Implement agreed best practices while striving for continuous improvement.
* Develop and foster client relationships and ensure we exceed their expectations and are their provider of choice.
* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.
* Monitoring of actual versus target hours per fund/client and action as required. Ensure there is a continuous drive to improve our efficiency.
* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.
* KPI’s to be consistently above the specified target for each team in your region (accuracy, timeliness, and delivery)
* Team capacity planning and full awareness of incoming pipeline, including ownership of hire requests.
* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends.


**Skills Required:**
* Bachelor or Master level degree.
* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).
* Motivated, bright, and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines \& targets.
* Attention to detail and ability to work on multiple projects.
* A team player who is genuinely motivated by improving our service and teams.
* An ability to think critically and objectively while having strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.
* A detailed understanding of the various fund types covered by this role (Private Equity, Real Estate, Credit \& Venture Capital).


**What you will get in return:**
* A unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business and to lead teams across different locations.
* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.
* Exposure to many different fund types and a wide variety of clients.
* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.
* Training and development opportunities.

 Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

 , part of the Investment Corporation of Dubai, is a leading GCC construction group with over two decades of success delivering some of the region’s most complex and high\-profile projects.  ALEC Holdings serves as the central hub for governance, finance, risk, and shared services, enabling business units across the Group to operate with consistency, control, and confidence.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 As a
 **Risk \& Internal Audit Senior Analyst** 
 , you will play a key role in strengthening ALEC’s governance framework and supporting informed decision\-making across the organisation. Your work will directly contribute to improving internal controls, managing risk, and enhancing operational efficiency across diverse business units.
 



 At ALEC, we don’t just build iconic projects, we build strong, sustainable businesses and exceptional careers.

 Our Risk \& Internal Audit function operates within a
 **lean, high\-impact structure** 
 , currently consisting of two team members, including this role.
 



 Reporting directly to the Head of Risk \& Internal Audit, you will work closely with finance, operations, and senior stakeholders across the business. The team operates in a
 **hands\-on, delivery\-focused environment** 
 , where individuals are expected to take ownership of their work and contribute both from an execution and advisory perspective.

data.jd_text:
The
 **Head of Business Intelligence** 
 will own and lead the end\-to\-end BI strategy, architecture and insight delivery across the business. This role is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, actionable intelligence that enables leadership teams to make faster, smarter and more profitable decisions.
 



 You will build and lead a high\-performing BI function, establish best\-in\-class reporting standards, and partner closely with Commercial, Trading, Merchandising, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and senior leadership to drive measurable business impact.
 



 This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role requiring strong technical expertise, commercial acumen and the ability to translate data into decision\-ready insight.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**BI Strategy \& Architecture** 



* Define and own the group\-wide BI roadmap across DTC and marketplace channels.
* Translate trading, pricing, merchandising, supply chain and finance requirements into scalable data models and reporting layers.
* Design and maintain a single source of truth across brands, regions and channels, despite fragmented upstream systems.
* Set clear ownership of raw data, transformed layers, business logic and reporting views.



**Data Integration \& Pipelines** 



* Lead the structuring and transformation of core data tables including orders, traffic, pricing, promotions, logistics, inventory and returns.
* Build and maintain robust pipelines to support daily, weekly and near real\-time trading decisions.
* Partner closely with technology and data teams to improve data reliability, timeliness and accessibility, and to define new data fields or views where required.



**Reporting, Dashboards \& Analytics** 



* Design decision\-first dashboards that drive action, not just visibility.
* Create standardised reporting frameworks while accommodating brand\-level nuances.
* Enable self\-serve analytics for trading, finance and senior leadership teams.



**Business Partnering \& Decision Support** 



* Act as a strategic BI partner to Trading and Commercial teams, proactively surfacing insights, risks and opportunities.
* Help evolve the organisation from reactive reporting to proactive and predictive insight.



**Data Governance \& Quality** 



* Define clear data definitions, metric logic and documentation to eliminate multiple versions of the truth.
* Implement data quality checks, alerts and reconciliation processes to ensure trust in reporting.



  





**What You’ll Bring** 



* 12\+ years’ experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics or Data, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Strong background in e\-commerce, fashion retail or consumer\-facing brands.
* Expert\-level SQL (BigQuery preferred) and deep understanding of modern data warehousing and modelling concepts.
* Advanced experience with BI tools such as Tableau or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar for data analysis, automation or advanced analytics.
* Strong commercial mindset with a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* Experience building and scaling BI teams in fast\-growth, high\-change environments.

data.jd_text:
Executive Opportunity: Head of Regional Sales (MEA)
 



  





 Zenith Technologies
 



 Location: Riyadh, KSA based
 



 Start Date: Immediate
 



 ⸻
 



 About Zenith
 



  





 Zenith Technologies, founded in Melbourne and established across Australasia and the Middle East, is a recognized leader in Homeland Security, Intelligence Systems, and Advanced Security Technologies.
 



  





 For over 15 years, Zenith has partnered with governments, ministries of interior, defense organizations, and elite law enforcement agencies to deliver end\-to\-end mission\-critical solutions that fuse physical, digital, and cyber domains. Our solutions are engineered entirely in\-house, giving us unmatched flexibility to innovate, customize, and deliver at scale.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Our Portfolio
 



  





 Zenith’s portfolio reflects a track record of world\-first innovations and proprietary platforms that transform how governments and agencies secure their nations. Key domains include:
 



 • Intelligent Mobility \& Enforcement Systems – including the world’s first AI\-powered Intelligent Lightbar, combining ANPR, live data analytics, communications, and edge AI for real\-time enforcement and situational command.
 



 • Next\-Generation ANPR \& Video Analytics – advanced fixed, mobile, and covert platforms enabling real\-time vehicle intelligence, threat detection, and multi\-domain data correlation.
 



 • AI\-Powered Data Fusion \& Analytics – proprietary platforms that ingest and integrate structured and unstructured data streams, delivering actionable intelligence and predictive insights to decision\-makers at speed.
 



 • Open\-Source Intelligence (OSINT) \& Social Media Monitoring – cutting\-edge solutions for live monitoring, deep\-data correlation, and AI\-enhanced threat intelligence across open sources, social media, and digital ecosystems.
 



 • Command \& Control Solutions – scalable, integrated C4i platforms enabling strategic oversight, rapid response, and mission\-critical decision\-making across multiple agencies.
 



 • Cyber\-Physical Security Integration – bridging digital and physical domains to deliver end\-to\-end national security resilience against emerging threats.
 



  





 Zenith’s unique strength lies in IP ownership and in\-house R\&D, enabling us to deploy fully integrated ecosystems rather than fragmented systems — a decisive advantage in the Homeland Security, National Resilience, and Law Enforcement sectors.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 The Role
 



  





 Zenith is seeking a Head of Regional Sales (MEA) to drive strategic expansion across the GCC, with primary focus on the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
 



  





 Reporting directly to the Group CEO, this executive will lead Zenith’s market growth, government engagement, and multimillion\-dollar program delivery across one of the world’s most dynamic security environments.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Key Accountabilities
 



 • Define and execute regional sales strategy aligned with Zenith’s growth objectives.
 



 • Lead high\-level engagements with Ministries of Interior, law enforcement, and homeland security agencies across KSA and GCC.
 



 • Manage full lifecycle: pipeline development, bid and proposal management, high\-stakes negotiation, and closure of complex projects.
 



 • Build, lead, and inspire a high\-performing regional sales force.
 



 • Establish and deepen strategic alliances with leading system integrators and security partners.
 



 • Deliver strong commercial outcomes while ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and market leadership.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 • 10\+ years in senior sales leadership within Homeland Security, Security Technology, or Defense.
 



 • Minimum 5 years of demonstrable success in the GCC, with direct experience engaging KSA MOI.
 



 • Proven track record in structuring and closing multimillion\-dollar government security contracts.
 



 • Strong professional networks across security, defense, and law enforcement communities in the region.
 



 • Master’s degree (Business or Engineering), MBA preferred.
 



 • Fluent in both Arabic and English.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 What Zenith Offers
 



  





 This is a high\-impact executive mandate within one of the most respected innovation\-driven players in the homeland security sector. Zenith offers:
 



 • Attractive executive package (base \+ commission).
 



 • Opportunity to shape national\-level security transformation.
 



 • A platform to operate at the intersection of AI, intelligence, and homeland security innovation in one of the fastest growing regions globally.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 Submit your CV (PDF/Word) to employment@zenith.com.au
 



 Subject line: “Head of Regional Sales (MEA) – \[Your Name]”
 



  





 Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

**Position Overview**
**Details of the role and how it fits into the team**
 Institutional Cash and Trade (ICT) is part of Deutsche Bank’s Corporate Bank and a leading provider in payments (\#1 EUR clearer) and trade finance solutions for Financial Institutions across the globe. ICT’s product offering includes cross border payments, FX solutions, liquidity management and trade finance \& lending. Our international team is based in \>25 countries and covers clients across :140 markets. We set industry trends by being a thought leader and acting as the clients’ Global Hausbank advisor and solution provider.
   

  

 To expand our client coverage beyond top tier commercial banks and central banks across the globe, we are looking for a Client Sales Manager Fintech to join our organization effective immediately.
   

  

**What we will offer you:**
 A healthy, engaged and well\-supported workforce is better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its center.
   

  

**You can expect:**
* Life Insurance
* Accidental Death Insurance
* Permanent Partial Disability Insurance
* Private Medical Insurance for you, your spouse and dependent children
* Flexible working arrangements
* 30 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday \& Flexible Working Arrangement
* DB contributions to DIFC Employee Workplace Savings (DEWS)


**Your key responsibilities:**
* You are responsible for driving the MENA FinTech sales strategy to meet ambitious revenue objectives through new client acquisition including targeted sales and marketing campaigns
* You build comprehensive and lasting client relationships with MENA FinTech clients and prospects to win their cross\-border payments business and drive further cross\-sell
* You collaborate effectively with Product Management, Technology and Corporate Cash to drive the development of targeted client solutions based on client demand and market feedback
* You represent ICT at industry forums and client seminars as a subject matter expert for FinTechs and cross\-border payment solutions
* You manage effectively KYC/AML risk for your respective FinTech portfolio to ensure full compliance with laws and regulations as well as internal risk appetite, polices \& procedures
* You report directly to the Head of Fintech Sales for Cash \& Trade Finance and are directly responsible for sales / P\&L


**Your skills and experience:**
* Degree from an internationally renowned university, combining technical engineering education with business\- or strategic management qualification.
* Proven ability to bridge client objectives, regulatory requirements and core technology delivery. Prior hands\-on experience in technology or digital delivery roles (e.g. engineering, solutions design, system integration) strongly preferred.
* Ability to translate regulatory expectations into operating models, technology controls, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms, and to engage confidently with internal and external regulatory stakeholders.
* Strong expertise in cross border payments and liquidity management solutions. Formal training or certification in data analytics, AI for business, agile product management or service design.
* Proven experience operating in regulated financial services environment, including AML, KYC, sanctions screening or financial crime framework.
* A team player and highly motivated leadership personality who wants to succeed and drive the business forward
* Fluent in English, other languages a plus


**How we’ll support you:**
* Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
* Training and development to help you excel in your career


**About us and our teams:**
 Deutsche Bank is the leading German bank with strong European roots and a global network. click here to see what we do.
   

  

**Deutsche Bank \& Diversity**
 Our values define the working environment we strive to create – diverse, supportive and welcoming of different views. We embrace a culture reflecting a variety of perspectives, insights and backgrounds to drive innovation. We build talented and diverse teams to drive business results and encourage our people to develop to their full potential. Talk to us about flexible work arrangements and other initiatives we offer.
   

  

 We promote good working relationships and encourage high standards of conduct and work performance. We welcome applications from talented people from all cultures, countries, races, genders, disabilities, beliefs and generations and are committed to providing a working environment free from harassment, discrimination and retaliation.

data.jd_text:
**Life at Dubai Future Foundation** 




  





 Dubai Future Foundation (DFF) aims to realize the wise vision of Dubai’s leadership to institutionalize the envisioned future and forward\-thinking methodologies, while positioning Dubai as the leading city of the future. In partnership with its local and global partners from governments, companies, startups, and entrepreneurs, DFF drives joint efforts to collectively imagine, design, and execute the best possible future for humanity.
 



 Under the supervision of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Chairman of the Executive Council of Dubai, and Chairman of the Board of Trustees of DFF, the DFF runs and oversees many futureproofing projects and initiatives, such as the Museum of the Future, Area 2071, The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE, Dubai Future Accelerators, One Million Arab Coders, Dubai Future Academy, Dubai Future Solutions, Dubai Future Labs, Dubai Future Forum, and Sandbox Dubai. DFF’s efforts to share knowledge, adopt innovation, support entrepreneurs and innovative startups, build capacity, and promote forward\-thinking and foresight principles contribute to Dubai’s ambitions to be a role model for the cities of the future through the power of unlimited imagination, innovation, foresight and disruptive mindset.
 



  





 For more information on the initiatives, projects, and programs of Dubai Future Foundation, please visit the website: www.dubaifuture.ae
 



  





**Where does this role fit into the bigger picture?** 




  





 Dubai Future Foundation recently launched Sandbox Dubai, a Regulatory Sandbox that centers around four key themes: Artificial Intelligence, Health Tech, Green technology, and Real Estate technology. We would like to invite talented and experienced individuals to join our dynamic team as we embark on this journey.
 



  





 As we embrace the challenges and opportunities of the modern regulatory landscape, we are seeking talented individuals who are eager to contribute their expertise and creativity to the Sandbox Dubai initiatives. We aim to explore novel solutions, foster collaboration across sectors, and pave the way for transformative changes that benefit both consumers and industries of Dubai.
 



  





 In the broader context of Sandbox Dubai, the Project Manager reports to the Head of Operations of Sandbox Dubai and will collaborate closely with the Sandbox team leads in Strategy, Policy, and Partnerships.
 



  





**Project Manager** 




  





 As a Project Manager within Sandbox Dubai, you will lead and manage sandbox programs and projects, including regulatory experiments, industry pilots, and innovation frameworks from concept to delivery or handover. You will manage multiple sandbox projects, deploy and enhance processes, coordinate cross\-functional teams, drive project timelines, engage diverse Future Foundation’s strategic goals.
 



  





**Project Management** 




  




* Full Project Lifecycle: Manage the full project cycle including managing projects timelines, budgets, milestones, setting objectives, monitoring and tracking progress, post project analysis and reporting.
* Project Development: Pitch sandbox projects with business cases, feasibility reports, and risk assessments tailored to sandbox\-specific initiatives.
* Sandbox Design \& Execution: Develop sandbox programs focused on regulatory experiments, technology validation, and proof\-of\-concept pilots across Sandbox priority areas (Artificial Intelligence, Health Tech, Green technology, and Real Estate technology).
* Global Tech Monitoring: Track international regulatory and innovation trends in key priority sectors to enhance the design of future sandbox initiatives and connect global themes/trends with opportunities for Dubai.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with legal, policy, strategy, and partnership teams to ensure project compliance and cross\-sector success.
* Documentation: Create and maintain project records, perform lessons\-learned assessments, and present reports to senior management.
* Team Collaboration: Communicate regularly with Sandbox team members and stakeholders to ensure projects run smoothly, providing updates to the Head of Operations and Director of Sandbox Dubai.
* Stakeholder Engagement and Third\-Party Relationships.
* Partner and collaborate with industry leaders, government agencies, startups, and regulatory bodies to align project goals. Ensure regular communication, and logistics are in place.
* Lead workshops, roundtables, and innovation sessions with relevant stakeholders to drive regulatory alignment and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with the Legal, Strategy, and Policy Teams to define regulatory exemptions, licensing terms, and compliance protocols.
* Work closely with finance, procurement and other internal teams to oversee procurement, invoices, and contracts ensuring legal compliance in all transactions.
* Support the development of policy proposals, regulatory models, and whitepapers in collaboration with Policy and Legal Teams.
* Ensure all projects comply with Sandbox governance frameworks, legal protocols, and international regulatory standards.
* Collaborate with the Marketing \& Communications Teams to enhance project visibility through media outreach and branding campaigns.



  





**Why this role is important?** 




  





 This role is central to translating Sandbox Dubai’s regulatory innovation goals into actionable Sandbox projects that drive policy reform, technology adoption and economic competitiveness. Moreover, this role is critical for providing operational management for core Sandbox projects throughout their lifecycle, fostering cross\-sector collaboration, and thus accelerating Dubai’s transformation into a global innovation hub.
 



  





**What Dubai Future Foundation offers?** 




  





 We will offer you a unique opportunity to work with passionate people, support shapers of the future as well as work that has an impact, not only on the organization or the UAE but all of humankind.
 



  





 You will have the chance to work on exciting and new projects, work in a highly diverse and fast paced environment that fosters creativity, disruptive ideas and innovation.
 



  





**Skills** 




  




* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Public Policy, Law, Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Artificial Intelligence, or Technology Management. A Master’s degree is preferred.
* **Experience:** 
 Minimum of 7 years’ experience in project management, regulatory frameworks, or innovation\-driven programs with a proven track record of multi\-project management.
* **Specialization:** 
 Demonstrated experience in regulatory frameworks related projects, innovation ecosystems, and emerging tech pilots.
* **Industry Expertise:** 
 Experience working with government agencies, private sector entities, international organizations and technology hubs is required. Experience in one or more of the key priority thematic areas (AI/Technology, Healthcare, Infrastructure/Real Estate, or Sustainability) is strongly preferred.
* **Skills required:** 
 Excellent project management skills with high attention to detail and a strong dedication to completing projects within assigned deadlines, ability to multi\-task, coordinating multiple projects concurrently while partnering effectively with internal and external stakeholders. Demonstrable experience in regulatory modernization, strategic thinking, problem\-solving, project development, resource management, as well as using project planning and presentation tools (MS Project, PowerPoint, Excel, Power BI .. etc). Project management certifications (such as PMP/PMI\-Agile/SCRUM) preferred.
* **Communication and Stakeholder Engagement:** 
 Strong communication skills are required to effectively manage high\-level stakeholder relationships in public and private sectors and engage multidisciplinary teams. Ability to clearly articulate project updates to Sandbox and DFF leadership as well as external stakeholders, identify challenges, and mobilize cross\-team responses quickly.
* **Languages:** 
 Fluent in reading, writing \& presenting in both Arabic \& English.
* **Mindset:** 
 Agile, proactive, structured, self\-driven, and ready to work independently or as part of a collaborative team, and ability to drive cross\-functional collaboration, manage multiple projects, and meet tight deadlines.

1\. The Role
 



 Mada Media, a leading privately\-owned outdoor media entity in Dubai, is seeking an experienced
 **Director of Business Development** 
 to lead revenue growth, strategic partnerships, and new business opportunities across the media and advertising sector.
 



 The role is responsible for identifying, developing, and converting business opportunities that support Mada Media’s commercial growth objectives. The Director of Business Development will focus on expanding the company’s B2B client base, building strong relationships with agencies, brands, partners, and key stakeholders, and driving revenue through direct sales, strategic partnerships, and programmatic advertising opportunities.
 



 This position requires a commercially driven leader with strong experience in media, advertising, outdoor media, and digital/programmatic solutions. The successful candidate will be accountable for achieving financial targets, growing market presence, and strengthening Mada Media’s position as a leading media partner in the UAE.
 



 2\. Key Responsibilities
 


* Develop and execute the business development strategy to drive revenue growth and increase market share.
* Identify and pursue new B2B business opportunities across brands, media agencies, advertising agencies, government\-related entities, and strategic partners.

* Track business development performance, pipeline conversion, revenue forecasts, and achievement against targets.

 3\. Your Background

* Minimum 8–10 years of experience within media, advertising, outdoor media, digital advertising, or related industries.
* Prior experience at Director or Senior Manager level with responsibility for revenue growth and financial targets.
* Strong B2B sales experience with a proven ability to build and close business opportunities.
* Strong knowledge of the UAE advertising and media market.
* Experience working with brands, media agencies, advertising agencies, and strategic partners.
* Programmatic advertising experience or understanding is strongly preferred.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.



 Desirable
 


* Arabic language skills are an advantage.
* MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Existing network within the UAE media, advertising, agency, and brand ecosystem.
* Experience in out\-of\-home advertising, digital media, programmatic, or ad\-tech solutions

data.jd_text:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Director, Business Development, Corporate Solutions \- B2B Acceptance
   

  

**Overview**
 This role sits within Corporate Solutions and is responsible for developing and scaling Mastercard’s B2B Acceptance strategy across East \+ West Arabia and Eastern Europe. You will help acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and merchants unlock new commercial payment flows.
   

  

 B2B Acceptance is a significant growth opportunity. Corporate buyers increasingly want to pay suppliers using commercial and virtual cards, particularly for invoice\-based payments. For acquirers and merchants, this creates an opportunity to capture new high\-value flows, improve cash flow, reduce manual processes and enable better reconciliation through data and straight\-through processing.
   

  

 Key questions
   

  

* Do you have a track record of building and scaling commercial payment products or acceptance\-led growth strategies?
* Can you influence senior executives across banks, acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and large merchants?
* Are you motivated by solving commercial and operational problems through technology, data and partnerships?
* Can you turn market trends into execution plans that drive GDV, revenue and merchant activation?


 Role
   

  

* Develop and execute the EEMEA B2B Acceptance strategy to retain, grow and expand Mastercard’s commercial acceptance footprint.
* Drive incremental commercial volume and revenue by enabling acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and merchants to capture high\-value B2B and invoice\-based payment flows.
* Remove operational barriers to B2B acceptance, including onboarding friction, manual processing, reconciliation challenges, supplier education and acceptance visibility.
* Build and scale market strategies for virtual card acceptance, supplier enablement, straight\-through processing and automated reconciliation.
* Provide thought leadership to global product teams on B2B merchant, acquiring, fintech, PSP, AP/AR, ERP and embedded finance opportunities.
* Lead digital presence, market insights, research and sales enablement for Commercial Acceptance across Eastern Europe and the Middle East.
* Build educational collateral and go\-to\-market playbooks to support banks, acquirers, fintechs, merchants and internal teams.
* Partner with Commercial Solutions, issuers, acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and account teams to activate commercial acceptance assets and partnerships.
* Manage dashboards and KPIs covering merchant activation, supplier enablement, GDV, net revenue, pipeline conversion and partner performance.
* Ensure Mastercard resources are deployed effectively to support commercial outcomes, market priorities and scalable regional growth.


**All About You**
* Strong understanding of acquiring, merchant economics, commercial card acceptance, virtual cards and B2B payment flows.
* Proven ability to build and scale product value propositions, particularly across acquiring, merchant or supplier enablement.
* Experience in Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, ERP, procurement, embedded finance or invoice\-based payments is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial mindset, with experience managing revenue growth, pipeline execution, business performance or P\&L\-related outcomes.
* Executive presence and consultative sales experience, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders internally and externally.
* Strong analytical capability, including the ability to use data to build business cases, track performance and shape strategy.
* Collaborative, entrepreneurial and execution\-focused, with the ability to work across a matrixed organization and turn strategy into measurable outcomes.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 Time allocation:
   

  

* 40% leadership

data.jd_text:
Are you a world\-class growth leader with a proven track record of scaling customer lifetime value (LTV) across global digital products? At Kape Technologies, we’re building the future of cybersecurity and consumer privacy through a diverse portfolio of privacy and security brands, including ExpressVPN, ExpressKeys, ExpressMailGuard, ExpressAI, Identity Defender, CyberGhost, Private Internet Access, EventVPN and Holiday.com.
   

  

 We’re looking for a VP / Director of Lifecycle \& Retention Marketing to own and scale the global lifecycle and retention engine across this portfolio as we expand into new markets and B2B opportunities. In this high\-impact role, you’ll operate at the intersection of growth, product, and data, leading a high\-performing team to shape how millions of users and businesses engage with and stay loyal to our products—while driving Kape’s evolution into a top global cybersecurity company.
   

  

 You will lead a team of \~20 across CRM, lifecycle, pricing, and CRO, defining the next generation of retention through AI\-driven personalization, advanced experimentation, and world\-class customer journeys.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

 Define \& Scale the Lifecycle Growth Strategy
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle marketing strategy across all brands, with a clear mandate to maximize LTV, reduce churn, and accelerate revenue growth. Build and execute a global roadmap spanning onboarding, engagement, renewal, upsell, and winback.
   

  

 Lead a Best\-in\-Class Retention Organization
   

  

 Build, scale, and inspire a high\-performing team of \~20 across CRM, lifecycle marketing, and CRO. Develop strong leadership layers, elevate talent, and foster a culture of accountability, experimentation, and impact.
   

  

 Own Monetization \& Pricing Strategy
   

  

 Drive the evolution of pricing, packaging, and monetization levers across multiple products. Partner closely with Product and Finance to optimize subscription models, promotions, add\-ons, and upgrade paths that maximize long\-term customer value.
   

  

 Drive AI\-Powered CRM \& Personalization
   

  

 Leverage cutting\-edge CRM platforms and AI\-driven tools to deliver highly personalized, data\-driven customer experiences at scale. Continuously evolve segmentation, targeting, and automation strategies.
   

  

 Optimize the End\-to\-End Customer Journey (CRO \& Lifecycle)
   

  

 Own the intersection of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and lifecycle marketing, ensuring seamless, high\-converting user journeys across all touchpoints—from onboarding through renewal.
   

  

 Build a Unified Retention Ecosystem
   

  

 Partner cross\-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to create a cohesive retention and monetization engine. Align incentives, roadmaps, and execution to deliver business impact.
   

  

 Champion Data\-Driven Growth
   

  

 Establish best\-in\-class analytics and experimentation frameworks. Deeply understand and optimize key metrics including churn, resurrection, winback, upsell, renewal rates, and LTV.
   

  

 Hands\-On Leadership in a Scaling Environment
   

  

 Operate as both a strategic leader and an execution partner—comfortable rolling up your sleeves to unblock teams, launch initiatives, and drive results, especially in a high\-growth or smaller company environment.
   

  

 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* 8–10\+ years of experience in lifecycle, retention, or growth marketing within high\-scale digital, SaaS, or cybersecurity businesses
* Proven track record of driving LTV growth, reducing churn, and scaling monetization
* Leadership experience managing teams of 10\+, with the ability to build and scale organizations
* Deep expertise in CRM, lifecycle marketing, experimentation (CRO), and retention strategy
* Strong experience with pricing and subscription monetization models
* Familiarity with AI\-driven marketing tools, automation, and advanced segmentation
* Highly data\-driven, with strong analytical and experimentation capabilities
* Hands\-on operator who can execute as well as lead
* Exceptional cross\-functional collaborator across Product, Sales, Data, and Customer teams
* Clear, compelling communicator who can align and inspire at all levels


**Before you apply**
* At the moment, we do not sponsor visas in the EU. For Hong Kong, we require at least two years of working experience and a university degree in a related field. For Singapore and the UK, we can only sponsor visas for mid\-career or above.
* Please upload your resume as a PDF and do not include any salary or compensation information in it.


*ExpressVPN is one of the world’s leading providers of online privacy and security services for consumers. Started in 2009, we’ve grown to have millions of active paying customers, a team of more than 700 people worldwide, and a brand recognized by hundreds of millions of people in 18 languages and more than a hundred countries. We see huge growth in our industry, and are gaining market share through strong execution.*

data.jd_text:
The First Group Hospitality is a Dubai\-headquartered, full\-service hospitality management company specialising in hotel operations, asset management, and F\&B strategy. With a team of industry veterans and a proven track record, the company delivers tailored solutions that enhance efficiency, optimise revenue, and maximise asset value for investors and hotel owners.
   

  

 As a trusted third\-party hotel management provider, The First Group Hospitality partners with leading global brands to drive operational excellence and long\-term profitability, thanks to expertise spanning property performance optimisation, cost management, and guest experience enhancement.
   

  

 Beyond management, The First Group Hospitality develops and operates a dynamic portfolio of upscale hotels, residences, and award\-winning restaurants, creating high\-value hospitality assets that stand out in the market. For more information, visit tfghospitality.com
   

  

 The Director of Revenue Management is responsible for maximizing revenue growth and optimizing profitability across all revenue\-generating channels in the hotel. This role entails setting and executing pricing strategies, managing inventory, and analyzing market data to drive revenue performance. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with deep analytical expertise and a strong understanding of market trends, customer behavior, and distribution channels.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
- Strategic Revenue Management

* Develop and implement revenue management strategies and pricing models to maximize room revenue and market share.
* Conduct regular revenue analysis and forecasting to inform business decisions and strategic planning.
* Monitor competitive market trends and adjust pricing strategies as necessary to maintain a competitive edge.


- Inventory and Pricing Control

* Oversee the distribution and management of room inventory across all booking channels.
* Set room rates, packages, and promotions based on forecasted demand, market conditions, and competitive intelligence.
* Manage and optimize distribution channels, including OTAs, brand website, GDS, and other online and offline channels.


- Performance Analysis

* Track, analyze, and report on key revenue metrics, including RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, and market share.
* Regularly review and interpret revenue performance reports to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior management to support revenue and profitability goals.


- Cross\-Departmental Collaboration

* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Reservations, and Operations teams to align revenue strategies with overall business goals.
* Provide training and guidance to sales and front office teams on revenue management principles and upselling techniques.
* Work closely with marketing teams to develop promotions and campaigns that drive occupancy and ADR.


- Technology and Systems Management

* Utilize revenue management software (e.g., RMS, CRS, PMS) to manage data and make data\-driven decisions.
* Oversee the implementation and maintenance of technology solutions that support revenue management processes.
* Ensure data integrity and accuracy in revenue management systems and processes.


- Market Intelligence

* Conduct ongoing competitive analysis, including pricing, positioning, and market trends.
* Keep abreast of industry changes, new technologies, and best practices in revenue management.
* Develop market segmentation and customer profiling strategies to enhance targeting and pricing precision.


- Budgeting and Forecasting

* Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process for all revenue streams, including rooms, F\&B, and ancillary services.
* Ensure that revenue targets align with overall financial goals and provide regular updates on performance against budget.
* Identify opportunities to increase incremental revenue through upsell programs and ancillary offerings.
* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field
* Minimum 7\-10 years of experience in Revenue Management within the hospitality industry
* At least 3\-5 years in a leadership or multi\-property revenue management role
* Strong knowledge of hotel distribution channels, pricing strategies, and market segmentation
* Experience working with major hotel PMS, RMS, CRS, and channel management systems.
* Proven track record of driving RevPAR, ADR, and occupancy growth Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and act on complex data sets.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present to senior management and influence key stakeholders.

* Demonstrated success in a business development / sales role with consistent achievement against quotas or revenue targets (new business acquisition focus).

 path could look like: Business Development Director → Senior Business Development Director / Sales Leader → Regional Sales Head / Commercial Director (Funds).

 CSC is a global business, legal, and financial services company based in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, providing knowledge\-based solutions to clients worldwide. **Description**
**Job Purpose:**
 To manage the overall complete company financial and operational performance of the respective areas of responsibility as per the guidelines given by Chief Executive Officer. To ensure strict adherence to the scope of work detailed in the terms and conditions of the contract under the individual’s management. Ensure that strict cost control systems are established in all departments in the operation, and that they are constantly maintained and monitored. To ensure that storage and stock control systems are maintained up to date, and to monitor stock rotation and validity. To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Duties**
* To ensure that the contract is operated within the budgetary margins established for the operation.
* To maintain constant liaison with the Client representative for the individual’s operation and establish a good working relationship.
* To monitor ordering of all supplies/requirements both internally on site and from the supplier.
* To ensure that validity of all employee documentation, e.g. security passes, medical certificates, licenses, vacations where applicable, are maintained and that timely action is taken for renewal that will not adversely affect the individual’s operation.
* To ensure employee time sheets are correctly filled in and that they are forwarded to Head Office on time each month.
* To liaise with Training Department for Staff Trainings.
* To conduct job training on the individual’s operations.
* To carry out annual evaluations of staff. Make recommendations for employee promotions, salary changes, employee of the month, disciplinary action, including termination where applicable.
* To ensure that employees are aware of the company policies and procedures and to ensure compliance.
* To ensure that the individual is aware of the contents of the KSA labor Law, and its stipulations regarding disciplinary action in particular.
* To ensure that leave schedules are maintained, and that requests for relievers are submitted to CEO at least two months in advance.
* To ensure strict confidentiality of all company financial information regardless of its nature.
* To compile and submit to CEO monthly reports on all aspects of the operations that should highlight any problems encountered and actions taken to rectify them.
* This report should cover maintenance activities, including both planned and reactive tasks, which are completed within required timeframes, on\-going or new projects information, supplier communications and enhancement schemes for the cost\-effective management of services.
* To ensure that copies of all Client correspondence, minutes of site meetings and any other communication (verbal or written) pertained to the operation are transmitted to the CEO immediately upon acknowledgment.
* The CEO must review on all offers to the Client prior to submittal. Site Engineers, where applicable, must be involved in offers pertaining to anything within the individual’s discipline.
* To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled. CEO must be informed of any major R\&M activity.
* To ensure that highest standards of health, hygiene and safety are maintained in the individual’s operation and to liaise closely with the company’s CEO on these matters.
* Closely monitor the performance of all the department heads.

* To perform any other duties requested by the CEO out of the normal routine but within the scope of work.
