* To conform to the Company’s guidelines related to the area as detailed in the Company’s Quality Assurance Program developed on the basis of ISO 9001:2000 Q.M. S

data.jd_text:
**About Lucidya**
 Lucidya is an AI\-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
   

  

 Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in\-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 Enterprise clients don't churn because of the product. They churn because implementation fails, adoption stalls, or they never get to the outcome they were sold.
   

  

 As Lucidya moves upmarket \- BFSI, telecom, media, retail \- the complexity of deployments grows. Onboarding a large enterprise is no longer a handoff. It's a multi\-month, multi\-stakeholder programme with real financial and reputational stakes on both sides.
   

  

 This role owns that entire delivery motion. You will build and lead the team responsible for getting customers from signed contracts to measurable value \- and keeping them there. You will own the managed services P\&L and the operational rigour that separates a world\-class implementation function from a reactive project management team.
   

  

 If you are energised by building structure in complexity, are equally comfortable in a client boardroom and a resource planning spreadsheet, and want your work to directly determine whether enterprise customers succeed \- this role is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Lead delivery end\-to\-end.**
* Execute the PMO strategy across customer onboarding, implementation, migration, and ongoing managed services \- translating strategic direction into reliable, repeatable delivery
* Ensure every project is delivered within scope, on time, and within budget \- and that CSAT and NPS reflect it
* Serve as the executive escalation point when projects hit risk. You do not wait to be told \- you see it coming
* Develop, enforce, and continuously improve standardised delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid depending on the engagement)


**Own the commercial side of services.**
* Own the deal economics for managed services \- project profitability, gross margins, and commercial accountability for the delivery function
* Forecast team capacity, manage utilisation, and optimise staffing across implementation specialists, project managers, analysts, and designers to match pipeline demand
* Work with Sales to scope SOWs accurately. Overpromising at the deal stage is a delivery problem \- you have a say in preventing it


**Build and develop the team.**
* Lead a team of Project Managers, Implementation Specialists, and Programme Managers
* Mentor the team on advanced client management, negotiation, risk mitigation, and how to balance client customisation requests against platform scalability
* Build a culture of product stewardship \- the team should be Lucidya's strongest advocates for what the platform does well, not just executors of client requests


**Be the bridge between clients and the business.**
* Manage expectations on custom development by bridging communication between clients and Engineering and Product teams \- clearly, without overpromising
* Report project health, velocity, and risk to executive leadership in a way that enables fast decisions
* Partner with clients on internal capability building \- recruitment of client\-side resources, upskilling programmes, and adoption ramp plans that increase their self\-sufficiency over time
* Drive continuous improvement. Every delivery cycle should produce lessons that shorten the next one


 You are responsible for outcomes: delivery quality, margin, client satisfaction, and a team that gets better every quarter.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You have 7\-10\+ years of professional experience, with at least 3\-5 years leading project or delivery teams inside a SaaS environment
* You have run complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise implementations \- and you have the scars to prove it
* You are as comfortable in a C\-suite escalation conversation as you are in a weekly project status call. You know how to communicate risk without creating panic
* You understand the commercial side of services. Margin, utilisation rates, and SOW scope are not someone else's problem

**Who We Are**
 At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology\-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end\-to\-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line\-haul transportation, last\-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross\-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.
   

  

**Our Global Reach**
 JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross\-border movement. Today, we operate 130\+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.
   

  

 Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people\-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast\-evolving industry.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high\-quality results in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Project Lifecycle Management: This includes project initiation, making project plans, detailing project work content, adjusting project plans according to the actual situation, and coordinating with project stakeholders to complete the work, ensuring high\-quality project delivery . 2\. On\-site Project Implementation Management, coordinating resources from all parties to ensure that the civil construction renovation, power and communication system, installation and commissioning of logistics automation equipment, and other tasks are carried out in an orderly manner, proceed as planned, and are delivered on time. 3\. Project Delivery and Integration: Collaborating with planning, operations, R\&D, equipment supplier, and other parties, organizing project training, on\-site setup, warehouse relocation, and starting operation to ensure a smooth project launch.
* Accumulation of Project Implementation Techniques and Standardization Construction: Based on the practice of Middle East project construction and operation, accumulate and compile Middle East project construction standards from the principles of compliance, efficiency, and economy, continuously iterate and improve to enhance the efficiency and quality of project construction.


 ﻿
   

  

**Job Requirements**
* Basic Requirements: Bachelor's degree or above, majors in Industrial Engineering, Logistics and supply chain management, Automation, and other related fields.
* Language Requirement: Fluent in English, capable of using it as a working language for meetings, reports, and project communication.
* Work Experience: More than 3 years of experience in project implementation, familiar with the overseas working environment and logistics policies, with experience in managing automated projects such as large\-scale warehousing centers, sorting centers, etc. Priority will be given to those with overseas project implementation experience.
* Basic Skills: Rigorous logical thinking and data sensitivity, good summarization and induction abilities, and data analysis capabilities. Proficient in at least one data analysis tool, such as EXCEL, SQL, Python, etc.
* Soft Skills: Possess strong project management and cross\-departmental coordination abilities, able to adapt to periodic business trips within the Middle East region. Have a structured thinking process, good at summarizing and extracting, and capable of distilling methodologies from projects.


*At JINGDONG Logistics, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*
**Ready to apply?**
 Take the next step in your career, apply now and explore the opportunities we have to offer.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**
* Extensive knowledge of Federal and State health and safety regulations and reporting procedures.
* Advanced knowledge of safety\-related national consensus standards (e.g., ANSI, NFPA).
* Exceptional interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.
* Ability to perform in a supervisory/managerial capacity.

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the planning and execution of all event operations and site\-wide delivery at Cultural and Heritage program, ensuring safe, efficient, and high\-quality delivery of cultural programming, guest experience, and large\-scale event operations in alignment with asset objectives
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Event Operations Planning \& Delivery**
* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution of all event operations across Cultural and Heritage program, including the Festival and year\-round programming
* Translate programming, marketing, and commercial plans into detailed operational delivery models
* Develop and manage event operations plans, schedules, and resource requirements
* Ensure seamless execution of all programming and activities in line with operational plans


**Logistics, Site Readiness \& Overlay**
* Lead planning and execution of logistics, site readiness, and event overlay (temporary infrastructure, structures, utilities, and services)
* Ensure readiness of all operational infrastructure prior to opening and across event cycles
* Oversee site setup, dismantling, and transition between events or programming phases
* Coordinate movement planning including access, transport, parking, and crowd flows


**Health, Safety \& Security (HSE)**
* Establish and enforce HSE and security frameworks across all operations
* Oversee crowd management planning, emergency response, and incident management protocols
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and authority requirements
* Coordinate with security agencies and government entities to ensure safe delivery


**Guest Experience \& On\-Ground Delivery**
* Ensure delivery of a high\-quality, safe, and seamless visitor experience across all touchpoints
* Oversee guest flow, queue management, accessibility, and service standards
* Monitor on\-ground performance and address operational issues in real time


**Vendor \& Operator Management**
* Oversee management of all operational vendors, contractors, and service providers
* Ensure vendor performance meets operational, safety, and service standards
* Coordinate with procurement and contract management functions


**Cross\-Functional Integration \& Feasibility**
* Lead operational feasibility assessment of programming, commercial, and marketing initiatives
* Ensure alignment between programming requirements and operational capabilities
* Work closely with:
+ Programming → feasibility and scheduling
+ Commercial → activation requirements
+ Marketing → campaign\-driven demand


**Asset \& Site Coordination**
* Coordinate closely with Asset \& Site Management on facilities, maintenance, and infrastructure readiness
* Ensure operational alignment with permanent and temporary asset requirements
* Support long\-term planning of site usage and capacity


**Asset Management \& Group Alignment**
* Align operational plans with Asset Management direction and performance expectations
* Coordinate with Qiddiya Group functions and external authorities where required
* Provide operational input into planning, budgeting, and performance reviews


**Performance Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track operational KPIs including service levels, efficiency, and safety
* Monitor performance during events and identify improvement opportunities
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives across operations


**Key Success Metrics**
* Operational delivery against plan
* Visitor experience and satisfaction
* Health, safety, and security performance
* Efficiency of event execution
* Readiness and delivery of major events


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong experience in large\-scale event operations and delivery
* Ability to manage complex logistics and site operations
* Strong knowledge of crowd management and HSE standards
* Ability to operate in high\-pressure, fast\-paced environments
* Cross\-functional coordination and execution capability


**Requirements**
* 12\-15\+ years of experience, with a significant portion in leadership roles overseeing large\-scale operations and event delivery
* Proven experience in:
* Planning and delivering large\-scale events, festivals, or destination operations with high visitor volumes
* Managing complex, multi\-site or multi\-zone environments involving diverse activities and stakeholders
* Leading end\-to\-end event operations, including planning, logistics, site readiness, and live delivery
* Strong experience in:
* Crowd management, HSE, and security operations within large public events
* Operational planning and logistics, including transport, access, and site movement
* Vendor and contractor management across multiple service lines
* Demonstrated ability to:
* Operate in high\-pressure, real\-time environments with critical decision\-making responsibilities
* Manage and coordinate with government authorities, regulatory bodies, and security agencies
* Lead large, cross\-functional operational teams and on\-ground workforce
* Experience in:
* Pre\-opening and activation phases of large\-scale venues, events, or destinations (preferred)
* Transitioning from readiness to live operations and managing ongoing operational cycles

* Experience leading teams, coordinators, and on\-ground staff during live events
* Experience in major national events, festivals, or large public events
* Experience in cultural or entertainment programming environments
* Experience in pre\-opening or launching large\-scale events is an advantage

- Lead teams of analysts and consultants on engagements, providing technical direction, quality assurance, and mentorship.

- Stay current on OT threat intelligence, emerging vulnerabilities, and regulatory developments in KSA and the wider GCC.

- Experience working within a management consulting firm, system integrator, or professional services organization in a client\-facing delivery role.

- Hands\-on proficiency with OT security frameworks and standards: IEC 62443, NIST CSF, ISA/IEC, and NCA ECC/OT\-CCC.

- Practical knowledge of industrial control systems and major ICS vendors: Honeywell, Siemens, Rockwell Automation, Schneider Electric, ABB, or Emerson.

- Solid understanding of OT network protocols (Modbus, DNP3, Profinet, OPC\-UA) and their security implications.

- Experience with OT\-specific security tools

- Strong report writing and client communication skills — ability to translate technical findings into clear risk narratives for operational and executive audiences.

- Arabic language proficiency strongly preferred; fluent English essential.

**Overview**
 As the leader for Joby’s future presence in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, you will build the business from the ground up, establishing the foundational relationships, operating model, and multi\-year strategy needed to launch a safe, compliant, and scalable service. Partnering closely with Joby’s senior leadership and U.S. headquarters teams, you will drive government and municipal engagement, develop strategic partnerships (including JVs and M\&A), and lead end\-to\-end deal execution. You will serve as Joby’s local face, elevating brand awareness, representing the company with stakeholders and media, translating market insights into action, and providing clear performance updates to executive leadership and the board.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build the Business Foundation: Lay the foundation for the future KSA market for Joby

* Corporate and Business Development: Source, evaluate, and execute M\&A, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships. Lead cross\-functional due diligence and manage deal execution from start to finish in the KSA
* Drive Strategic Execution: Implement a vision and multi\-year business strategy that balances execution across aircraft sales, business development, corporate development, government relations, OEM, manufacturing, and operations
* Develop Market Awareness: stay apprised of local trends, business opportunities, infrastructure opportunities, consumer mobility preferences, etc., within the KSA, and build action plans to exploit opportunities for Joby
* Collaborate with US Team: Work cross\-functionally with Joby’s US\-based headquarters functions to support global strategic initiatives and to support partner(s) in launching a successful, safe, and compliant service in the KSA
* Establish the Joby Brand Locally: Gather market insights and work closely with Joby’s marketing, business development, and communications teams to build a highly recognizable brand within the KSA
* Be the Local Face of Joby: Serve as the primary local representative of Joby at KSA events and with local press to drive awareness and early adoption

**About Zarafa** 




  





 Zarafa is a Riyadh\-based MEP \& HVAC company specializing in HVAC systems, ventilation, ductwork, cold rooms, kitchen exhaust, and electromechanical works across residential, commercial, and industrial projects.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for an MEP Project Manager who takes full ownership of projects from inquiry to handover.This is not only a site or estimation role. The right candidate is expected to manage pricing, execution, coordination, delivery, and project follow\-up with full responsibility for results.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 Phase 1 — Inquiry \& Estimation
 



 • Review drawings and specs, define the full scope, and flag any ambiguity before building a price
 



 • Prepare BOQ and calculate material, labor, equipment costs, and profit margin independently
 



 • Negotiate with suppliers and secure pricing before submitting the proposal
 



 • Deliver the proposal on time with a clear technical summary for the client
 



  





 Phase 2 — Planning \& Mobilization
 



 • Build a project execution timeline and identify all resources before mobilizing to site
 



 • Coordinate purchase orders and material delivery aligned with the execution schedule
 



 • Define labor requirements and assign responsibilities across site teams
 



  





 Phase 3 — Execution \& Control
 



 • Supervise daily site operations and ensure execution follows drawings and specs without compromise
 



 • Track progress against schedule and budget weekly — escalate deviations before they compound
 



 • Manage change orders commercially — document and get client sign\-off before executing
 



 • Solve field problems on the spot — no waiting for someone to tell you what to do
 



  





 Phase 4 — Handover \& Close
 



 • Oversee commissioning, system testing, and prepare the full handover package
 



 • Follow up with the client until final sign\-off and handover certificate is issued
 



 • Ensure invoices and collections are tracked and closed on time
 



  





**Requirements** 




  





 • BSc in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
 



 • 5 years of experience in MEP projects
 



 • Hands\-on experience preparing BOQ and proposals independently
 



 • Ability to read and work from MEP drawings and specifications
 



 • Experience managing site teams, suppliers, and subcontractors
 



 • Working English \& Arabic for technical correspondence and specs

data.jd_text:
Qiddiya is a pioneering development located just outside Riyadh, designed to become Saudi Arabia's leading destination for entertainment, sports, and culture. Spanning over 360 square kilometers, Qiddiya will feature everything from a Formula 1\-grade motor racing circuit and major sports venues to theme parks, performance spaces, and nature\-based attractions. The scale and complexity of the project offer professionals a rare opportunity to contribute to one of the largest and most ambitious urban developments in the world. We are building more than a leisure destination — we are creating a new economic sector and community from the ground up. With construction underway and key milestones approaching, we're hiring talent across multiple disciplines to help bring this vision to life. If you're looking to work on projects that combine innovation, scale, and long\-term national impact, Qiddiya presents a unique career opportunity.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the development and delivery of interactive maker space programs focused on crafts, creativity, and hands\-on cultural experiences.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design hands\-on, interactive maker space programs aligned with cultural themes
* Develop workshops, demonstrations, and creative experiences for different audiences
* Ensure diversity and accessibility of creative offerings

* Identify and onboard artisans, creators, and facilitators
* Manage schedules, participation, and delivery of workshops
* Ensure quality and consistency across all sessions


**Operational Readiness \& Setup**
* Ensure readiness of maker spaces, including tools, materials, and safety measures
* Coordinate with Operations and FM for setup and maintenance of spaces
* Manage resource planning and replenishment


**Program Delivery \& Visitor Engagement**
* Oversee delivery of workshops and interactive sessions
* Ensure high levels of participation and engagement
* Maintain safety and quality during all activities


**Performance Monitoring**
* Track participation rates and engagement levels

**Key Success Metrics**
* Participation in workshops
* Engagement levels
* Quality of experience
* Deliver asset operating budget

* Experience in creative programming or workshops
* Understanding of crafts, making, or cultural production

**Requirements**
* 5\-8\+ years of experience, with a strong background in creative programming, workshop delivery, or hands\-on cultural and educational experiences
* Proven experience designing and delivering interactive, hands\-on programs, workshops, or maker space activities
* Strong understanding of creative disciplines, such as crafts, design, traditional making, or cultural production
* Ability to develop engaging, accessible experiences for diverse audience groups (families, youth, adults)
* Experience working with:
* Artisans and craftspeople
* Creative practitioners and facilitators
* Ability to identify, onboard, and manage workshop facilitators and contributors
* Experience coordinating multiple facilitators delivering parallel sessions
* Proven ability to deliver interactive experiences in public\-facing environments
* Experience managing high visitor engagement environments with continuous participation
* Strong facilitation and communication skills to engage audiences directly

* Ability to ensure safe, controlled, and well\-supervised delivery of activities
* Experience managing physical creative spaces or studios, including setup, layout, and flow

* Experience coordinating space utilization for multiple simultaneous activities
* Experience in:
* Maker spaces, innovation labs, or creative hubs
* Museums, cultural institutions, or interactive exhibitions
* Festivals or public engagement programs

**Company Description**
 At QIMA, we are on a mission to offer our clients smart solutions to make products you can trust.
   

  

 Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence.

With client passion, integrity, and a commitment to making things simple, we disrupted the Testing, Inspection, and Certification industry. Are you ready to hop on this exciting ride with us and help us achieve our mission?
   

  

 Our Consumer Products Division is dedicated to helping brands, retailers and manufacturers worldwide deliver safe, quality and ethically made products to their consumers. Every day at work, our inspectors, auditors, lab techs, and certification specialists use their expertise to help safeguard the products you use every day in your home: from clothes and footwear to toys and baby products, to electronics, appliances, and furniture.

This role will report directly to the Head of Certification Unit working as part of our Client Service \& Program team.

data.raw_snippet: The Medical Readiness \& Training Manager is responsible for building and sustaining a city\-wide culture of emergency preparedness at Qiddiya. The role owns the full cycle of first aid and first responder training, certification compliance, emergency drill planning and evaluation, and event medical
data.jd_text:
The Medical Readiness \& Training Manager is responsible for building and sustaining a city\-wide culture of emergency preparedness at Qiddiya. The role owns the full cycle of first aid and first responder training, certification compliance, emergency drill planning and evaluation, and event medical readiness. Working within healthcare operations, the Manager ensures that Qiddiya's workforce is continuously trained, certified, and operationally ready to respond to medical emergencies across all venues and activations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 First Aid \& First Responder Training
   

  

* Design, deliver, and continuously improve first aid and first responder training programs aligned with AHA/SHA Heartsaver standards and applicable national requirements
* Develop and maintain training materials including manuals, skill\-station scenarios, simulation scripts, and competency assessment tools
* Supervise and mentor first aid instructors, ensuring consistent delivery quality and standardized assessment across all training cohorts
* Maintain city\-wide certification compliance, ensuring all designated staff hold valid AHA/SHA or equivalent credentials at all times, with proactive renewal tracking
* Coordinate with City Operations, HR, and department heads to embed certification requirements into onboarding and role\-specific duty conditions
* Produce monthly certification compliance dashboards and escalate gaps to the Executive Director, Healthcare Operations


 2\.2 Emergency Drills, Simulations \& Performance Reporting
   

  

* Design and manage annual drill and simulation calendar covering mass casualty incidents, medical emergencies, mass gathering scenarios, and venue\-specific response exercises
* Facilitate tabletop exercises and live simulations, coordinating participants across City Operations, and external partners as required
* Evaluate drill performance using standardized checklists, response time metrics, and team\-performance criteria; produce structured after\-action reports with corrective recommendations
* Track corrective action closure and retest through follow\-up drills to confirm sustained improvement in response performance


 2\.3 Public Health Awareness \& Community Outreach
   

  

* Plan and deliver an annual public health awareness calendar aligned with national health observances and Qiddiya's operational calendar, covering priority topics such as heat illness prevention, cardiac health, diabetes awareness, and mass gathering safety
* Coordinate with Marketing \& Communications to produce guest and staff\-facing health education content, including signage, digital materials, and event\-based messaging
* Build and maintain relationships with partner hospitals, referral facilities, and community health stakeholders to support integrated health promotion and care pathways for Qiddiya's workforce and guests
* Measure outreach reach and engagement and report outcomes to the Executive Director, Healthcare Operations


 2\.4 Vaccination Programs
   

  

* Plan and supervise staff vaccination drives in coordination with the healthcare provider and Ministry of Health requirements, covering seasonal influenza, meningitis, and other mandated or recommended programs
* 
* Track vaccination coverage rates against defined targets, maintain records, and produce reports for leadership and regulatory submission
* Coordinate logistics for vaccination campaigns including scheduling, venue setup, cold chain compliance, and post\-campaign adverse event monitoring


 2\.5 Volunteer Management
   

  

* Recruit, train, and coordinate a pool of volunteer first aiders drawn from across Qiddiya's workforce, maintaining their certification status and deploying them to supplement professional medical coverage at events and activations
* Develop and manage a roster of volunteer first aid instructors to support scaling of training delivery across the city, ensuring instructor quality through observation, feedback, and standardization
* Recruit and train Standardized Patients (SPs) to support realistic simulation exercises and emergency drills, managing their briefing, role preparation, and performance feedback to ensure high\-fidelity scenario delivery
* Maintain complete volunteer records including profiles, training history, certification status, deployment logs, and performance feedback; recognize and retain high\-performing volunteers to build program continuity


 2\.6 AED Network \& First Responder Readiness
   

  

* Oversee the city\-wide AED placement strategy, maintaining an up\-to\-date inventory of all devices, inspection schedules, and readiness status across all Qiddiya venues
* Build and maintain a layered first responder network across city departments, ensuring adequate coverage of trained lay responders at all operational areas and venues
* Promote the Qiddiya Life Saver program to grow bystander first aid capability among staff, embedding a culture of emergency preparedness across the city workforce


 2\.7 Event \& Venue Medical Readiness
   

  

* Conduct pre\-event medical readiness assessments for major activations, theme park openings, and mass gathering events, verifying that staffing, equipment, and trained responders meet defined standards
* Develop venue\-specific emergency response plans and coordinate readiness briefings with operational teams ahead of activations and high\-footfall periods


 2\.8 Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Prepare and present monthly readiness reports to the Executive Director, Healthcare Operations, covering training throughput, certification status, drill outcomes, and AED network status
* Identify and implement evidence\-based improvements to training, drill design, and readiness programs through data analysis, after\-action review, and benchmarking against mass gathering and entertainment industry standards


 2\.9 Regulatory Compliance \& Governance
   

  

* Ensure all training programs, certifications, and readiness activities comply with Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS), Ministry of Health, and Qiddiya governance requirements
* Maintain accurate records of all training, drills, certifications, and readiness assessments to support audit, accreditation, and regulatory inspection readiness
* Support CMS governance by contributing readiness data and insights to the broader healthcare operations reporting cycle


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Emergency Medical Services, Paramedicine, Nursing, Public Health, or a related clinical discipline
* Valid SCFHS professional license in a relevant clinical category
* Minimum 5\-7 years of experience in emergency medical services, healthcare training, or mass gathering medicine, with at least 2\-3 years in a training, education, or emergency preparedness role

* Collaborate with project leadership teams to integrate HSEW into project planning and execution strategies.
* Manage site security requirements and oversee third\-party security service providers.
* Support the development of Project Execution Plans, including HSEW frameworks during engineering and mobilization phases.
* Engage with clients, stakeholders, and regulatory bodies on all HSEW\-related matters.


**About You**

* Mandatory experience in high\-end luxury hospitality and residential projects in KSA.
* Strong background in construction, infrastructure, or mega\-project environments, preferably in remote locations.
* In\-depth knowledge of KSA HSE regulations, international standards (ISO 45001 / OHSAS 18001\), and best practices.
* Proven experience in developing and implementing corporate HSEW strategies and programs.
* Expertise in managing contractor safety performance and stakeholder coordination.
* Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Ability to present and report to senior leadership and client stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Safety Management Systems.

* Professional certifications (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent) preferred.

Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 100 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 19,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting\-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.
   

  





 With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 As the Investment and Business Development Director, you will spearhead the company's efforts in identifying and capitalizing on investment opportunities for sustainable urban development projects. Drawing upon your extensive experience in investment management and your deep understanding of the engineering industry, you will lead initiatives to attract funding, secure partnerships, and drive the financial success of our projects.
   

  





 The Investment and Business Development Director will work closely with the Investment Planning Director and the team.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* Investment and Business Development Strategy: Develop and execute a comprehensive Business development strategy aligned with projects objectives and market dynamics.
* Opportunity Identification: Conduct in\-depth market research and feasibility studies to identify potential investment opportunities in sustainable urban development projects.
* Investor Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with investors, financial institutions, and other stakeholders to secure funding and support for project development.
* Due Diligence: Conduct thorough due diligence on potential investment opportunities, including financial, legal, and technical assessments, to mitigate risks and ensure investment viability.
* Deal Structuring: Lead negotiations and structuring of investment deals, including equity investments, debt financing, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships.
* Compliance and Reporting: Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and reporting standards, and provide regular updates to stakeholders on investment performance and portfolio management.
* Team Leadership: Provide leadership and guidance to the investment development team, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and innovation.


**Additional Information**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or CFA designation preferred.
* Minimum of 15 years of experience in investment management, financial analysis, or corporate finance, with a focus on infrastructure or real estate investments.
* Strong understanding of investment principles, financial markets, and project finance structures.
* Proven track record of successfully sourcing, structuring, and closing investment deals, preferably in the infrastructure or real estate sector.
* Excellent analytical, quantitative, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex investment opportunities and risks.
* Effective communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders.
* Strategic thinker with a results\-oriented mindset, capable of identifying and pursuing profitable investment opportunities.
* Proficiency in financial modeling and valuation techniques; familiarity with investment analysis software is a plus.
* Fluency in English and proficiency in Arabic \- reading and writing.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Title: HSE Manager**
**About ENGIE**
 ENGIE Group is a global reference in low\-carbon energy and services. Together with our 96,000 employees, our customers, partners and stakeholders, we are committed to accelerate the transition towards a carbon\-neutral world, through reduced energy consumption and more environmentally friendly solutions. Inspired by our purpose (“raison d’être”), we reconcile economic performance with a positive impact on people and the planet, building on our key businesses (gas, renewable energy, services) to offer competitive solutions to our customers.
   

  

****Key activities and competencies****
**Strategic:**
* Develop a strategy for effective project occupational HSE management, including objectives, targets, and KPIs in line with ENGIE Group / AMEA HSE KPIs \& objectives.
* Collaborate with other departments to ensure compliance with Engie Group Rules (GRs) and develop AMEA\-specific HSE Standards.
* Develop both proactive and reactive HSE key performance indicators.


**Operational:**
* Provide HSE leadership and coordination to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and reduce the frequency and severity of adverse HSE events.
* Ensure consistent implementation of Project Company Health, Safety, and Environmental Standards during construction and commissioning up to COD and Operations.
* Maintain the Project Risk Register (HSE) and update it periodically based on actual risks.
* Manage high\-risk activities, including equipment logistics and lifting operations.
* Promote open and transparent Health, Safety, and Environmental reporting from the Project Company and Contractor(s) to AMEA Country HSE.
* Develop training, induction, and onboarding programs for Project Co. and contractors.


**Organisational:**
* Support the development of Engie HSE tools, procedures, and practices.
* Organise and participate in HSE campaigns and ensure contractor participation.
* Coordinate the design and delivery of HSE reports, presentations, and training programs.
* Support the HSE prequalification of contractors or subcontractors and assist in vendor selection.
* Monitor and measure Owners Engineer and contractor HSE performance.
* Conduct regular audits and site inspections to ensure contractor compliance with Project Company policies and procedures.
* Organise internal site peer reviews with recognized HSE experts.
* Manage the selection of third\-party auditors, consultants, and HSE contractors/practitioners
* Identify trends in Health and Safety performance and implement initiatives for improvement.
* Ensure compliance with environmental permits and maintain appropriate measurement, recording, and reporting systems.
* Develop robust emergency procedures and conduct regular drills.
* Support the development of HSE O\&M (Operational procedures review and validation).
* Facilitate internal and external benchmarking in construction HSE issues.
* Communicate lessons learned from other projects received from ENGIE and other sources.
* Manage relations with external partners on health, safety, and environmental issues (local authorities, equipment manufacturers, contractors, suppliers, etc.).


**Planning \& Delivery of Work:**
* Ensure HSE onboarding for everyone on the project through the Contractor.
* Oversee the development of comprehensive training programs for the workforce by Contractor(s).
* Assess and record the competency of HSE critical workforce.
* Implement and review a strict Construction Safe System Of Work (Permit to Work).
* Implement and review a strict Commissioning Safe System Of Work (Permit to Work).


**Decision Making:**
* Assess the effectiveness of risk management across the fleet and recommend actions for continuous improvement.
* Review and approve Project accident and incident investigations.
* Ensure proper and swift incident investigation to be performed by EPC contractors, including incidents occurring within subcontracted activities
* Assist and advise in the implementation of improvement and mitigation actions following incident investigations, ensure actions are closed and that lessons learned are circulated.
* Ability to work autonomously, prioritizing tasks and activities in line with business objectives.
* Ability to demonstrate support for innovation and for organizational changes, critical thinking.
* Maintains high ethical standards.


**Working with others:**
* Develop strong partnerships with the Project Construction Director, Country HSE Manager, other asset HSE teams, partners and external consultants where necessary.
* Work in coordination with the AMEA HSE network to enhance HSE awareness and engagement.
* Manage, mentor and develop your direct / indirect report in line with our People Development Strategy.
* Ability to work within a team of members from varying cultural backgrounds as well as with counterparts of varying cultural backgrounds.
* Able to work in a multicultural environment and with multidisciplinary teams
* Strong leadership abilities to engage people proactively to work towards project Safety Culture.
* Presence and interpersonal credibility to represent the Project Company with key stakeholders, JV partners and external organisations, Government representatives, Local \& national agencies.


****Key relationships****
 Internal:
   

  

* Project Company Management team, Employees, Owner Engineering team, Contractors \& Subcontractors
* Head of HSE RGBU AMEA
* Engie Group HSE
* internal Stakeholders representatives \& visitors
* Lenders Engineer and other internal inspectors / auditors.
* Assigned Medical service Provider(s)
* International SOS agency (ENGIE)


 External:
   

  

* Partner’s Representatives
* External consultants
* Government Regulatory authorities, Environmental inspection agencies.
* Local security agencies, police, emergency medical organisations.
* Local Communities (indirect).
* Other external Stakeholders and relevant parties including NGO’s (indirect).


****Required Qualifications****
 Qualifications:
   

  

* Recognised Engineering or science qualification
* Internationally recognized Safety and Health qualification (NEBOSH General Certificate or equivalent as a minimum).
* Accreditations preferred for Fire \& Risk management, Advanced First Aid, Confined Spaces, Emergency Response Rescue, Heavy Equipment inspection, scaffolding management.


 Experience:
   

  

* Minimum 15 years’ experience managing Health, Safety, Environment Projects as a Manager within the Power Generation Industry:
* Power generation technology including renewables (Solar project experience preferred)
* Water desalination and chemical treatment systems.
* Civil, mechanical and construction activities.
* Successful HSE track record within construction and commissioning of large\-scale Projects. (\>1 BUSD)
* Professional experience working in Remote Project locations in hardship environments.
* In depth understanding for implementing management systems such as ISO:45001 and ISO:14001\.
* Professional experience in managing HSE within a culturally diverse workforce and local population and other sensitive receptors (Stakeholder engagement \& management).
* Experience in Project Ethical standards, Welfare, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience with strict Environmental sensitive receptors and cultural heritage Management.
* Experience in Safety Management of complex Logistical mobilization of equipment \& resources over long distances.
* Experience in Overall Project Risk Register and Risk Mitigation Management.
* Experience in management Project Emergency Response Planning, in particular medical emergencies.
* Understanding in the application of International Standards (NFPA, ISO, OSHAD, etc.) as needed.
* Professional H\&S experience for complex construction activities including heavy lifting operations.


 Knowledge and Skills:
   

  

* High Proficiency in English (verbal and written), Hindi / Urdu, Arabic desirable but not essential.
* High level of HSE technical knowledge and understanding of Process Safety Management.
* Excellent communication, training, and presentation skills.
* High level of data analysis skills and experience in audit, inspection, and report writing.
* MS Office \& Social Media applications
* Proficiency utilising Noise monitoring, Atmospheric Gas testing, and environmental monitoring devices.


 Business Unit: GBU Renewables \& Flexible Power
   

  

 Division: GEN International \- KSA
   

  

 Legal Entity: ENGIE Regional Headquarters LLC
   

  

 Professional Experience: Skilled ( \>3 experience \<15 years)
   

  

 Education Level: Bachelor's Degree

**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 The Client Project Manager is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for leading and directing concurrent client projects classified as standard or complex.
   

  

 The primary responsibility of the Client Project Manager is to interface with all project stakeholders to take projects from original concept through to final implementation, including handing over to Operations (whether internal to the organization or into the client's support operations).
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Leads and directs concurrent standard or complex projects, often managing multiple projects in parallel within fast‑paced delivery environments.
* Engages with stakeholders to deliver projects from original concept through final implementation.
* Ensures client satisfaction and manages escalations, acting as a single point of contact to the client, demonstrating confidence, resilience, and a strong assertive delivery approach when faced with challenging stakeholders or high‑pressure situations.
* Ensures that the project delivers an as\-sold solution, remains within the baselined budget and is delivered on time whilst maintaining quality criteria and client satisfaction.
* Manages the delivery of the project, including rigorous scope control and change management.
* Documentation and management of risks and issues.
* Ensures clear and concise communications to all stakeholders.
* Provides pre\-sales support by working with sales teams to scope and cost a project solution which includes the completion of a proposal. This may include client presentations of our delivery approach as part of a tender process.
* Identifies opportunities and influences the sale by conducting a business conversation with the client, positioning organizational consulting and technical services offerings.
* Coordinates activities of the project teams through task delegation and resource assignment.
* Performs any other related task as required.


**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* 2–3 years of hands‑on project management experience, with the ability to plan, organize, and execute projects from initiation to completion.
* Ability to establish strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external clients.
* Ability to manage customer satisfaction, commitment, and expectations to high service levels, and manage escalations effectively with a firm, solutions‑driven mindset.
* Excellent communication skills are essential; this role requires a confident, resilient communicator who can challenge constructively and defend delivery commitments when required.
* Ability to work in high‑pressure environments.
* Ability to manage urgent and complex tasks simultaneously.
* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness.
* Passionate, high‑energy, self‑driven, and results‑oriented.
* Strong influencing ability whilst taking a collaborative approach.
* Competent in project change management.
* Strong IT services background is mandatory, with experience delivering projects related to infrastructure, systems, or enterprise technologies.
* Exposure to software application delivery and/or AI‑related projects is a strong advantage.
* Strong problem‑solving and analytical skills to identify and address issues that may arise during project implementation.


**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

 On\-site Working

**Job Title:** 
 HR Operations Manager
   

  

**Location:** 
 Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Position Overview**
**The HR Operations Manager** 
 will lead, and continuously improve all Human Resources Operations in Saudi Arabia. The role is responsible for ensuring that every aspect of the employee lifecycle is executed with precision, full legal compliance, and a high standard of service to both the business and its employees. The ideal candidate will bring deep knowledge of Saudi Labor Law, hands\-on experience with KSA government platforms, and the operational discipline to build structured HR processes in a dynamic, site\-based environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle Management
   

  

* Own and manage the end\-to\-end HR operations for MEP Contracting, Electrical Testing, and Facility Management divisions.
* Manage all onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring documentation accuracy, system entry into HRMS, and full compliance with company procedures.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records, contracts, and personnel files in both digital and physical formats.
* Coordinate inter\-project employee transfers and mobilization/demobilization processes in alignment with project timelines and management directives.


 Payroll Coordination \& Compensation Administration
   

  

* Gather, verify, and submit monthly payroll inputs — including attendance data, overtime, new hire additions, and terminations.
* Ensure strict compliance with the WPS and timely salary disbursement.
* Administer employee benefits including health insurance, annual leave entitlements, and End of Service Benefits (EOSB) calculations in accordance with Saudi Labor Law.
* Coordinate with the Group HR Director on compensation benchmarking and any salary structure updates.


 Government Relations \& Regulatory Compliance
   

  

* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for all KSA government HR platforms, including Qiwa, GOSI, Muqeem, Mudad, and HRSD.
* Manage Iqama renewals, work permit processing, and all government\-related employee documentation.
* Ensure full compliance with Saudi Labor Law (Articles 36 and 11 of Executive Regulations), Nitaqat/Saudization requirements, and all MHRSD directives.
* Monitor and act on Qiwa contract management, GOSI registration and contribution accuracy, and Muqeem residency status updates.
* Proactively track regulatory changes and update internal processes accordingly to prevent penalties and compliance failures.


 HR Policies, Procedures
   

  

* Implement and enforce Group HR policies and company specific procedures across all operational areas, including attendance management, leave administration, disciplinary processes, and code of conduct.
* Ensure accurate and timely data entry and maintenance in HRMS, including employee master data, leave balances, and contract details.
* Prepare periodic HR reports and dashboards for management and the Group HR Director, covering headcount, turnover, leave utilization, and compliance status.
* Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce operational risk.


 Employee Relations
   

  

* Act as the first point of contact for employees on all HR\-related queries, providing timely, accurate, and professional guidance.
* Manage employee relations matters, including grievances, disciplinary cases, and labor disputes, in strict accordance with Saudi Labor Law and company policy.
* Support the implementation of employee engagement initiatives and contribute to building a positive, performance\-oriented work culture.


**Qualifications, Experience \& Competencies**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is required.
* Professional HR certification (CIPD Level 3/5, SHRM\-CP, or equivalent) is highly preferred.


**Experience**
* Minimum 5–7 years of progressive HR experience in Saudi Arabia, with at least 2–3 years in an HR operations or supervisory role.
* Prior experience in the engineering, construction, MEP contracting, or facilities management sector is strongly preferred, given the project\-based and site\-intensive nature of operations.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience managing KSA government platforms.
* Solid working knowledge of Saudi Labor Law, including leave entitlements, EOSB calculations, WPS compliance, and disciplinary procedures.
* Experience working with an HRMS platform.


 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* High attention to detail and a process\-oriented mindset — accuracy in payroll and compliance data is non\-negotiable.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust with employees at all levels.
* Analytical capability to prepare meaningful HR reports and identify trends.
* Proactive problem\-solver who can work independently and take ownership of the HR function.
* Professional fluency in Arabic and English — both written and spoken.


**Hiring Process**
 To ensure a fair, objective, and comprehensive selection process, all applications will go through the following structured stages:
   

  

* Initial Screening: A thorough evaluation of your CV, professional certificates, past experience, alignment with the required qualifications, and your responses to the application questionnaire.
* Online Assessment Center: Candidates who successfully pass the initial screening will be invited to complete an online assessment. This will evaluate cognitive abilities, functional HR skills, and personality traits to ensure a strong fit for the role and company culture.
* Interviews: Candidates who meet the success threshold based on the combined scores of the initial screening and the online assessment center will be invited to formal interviews with the HR leadership and management.

data.jd_text:
**Overview**
 AtkinsRéalis is looking for a Construction Logistics Director (PMC), in Riyadh, KSA
   

  

 Your role
   

  

**Performance**
* Effective delivery of site\-wide logistics through the procurement of a site\-wide Logistics management contractor. Define and monitor that the scope of services is delivered satisfactorily through setting and monitoring of measurable goals and objectives around the following broad key enablers:
* Orderly, safe and efficiently movement of labour, plant, and materials around site.
* Planning the location of haul roads, laydown, external access and offloading zones to minimise obstruction and impacts to programme.
* Creation of a secure, well maintained site with regular (weekly) logistics meetings.
* Efficient and orderly management of any worker's'accommodation.
* Development of processes, procedures and induction programmes.
* Supply chain management, movement plans and lookahead forecasting.
* Ensuring logistics activities are not a constraining factor on the program
* Creating of site\-specific safety manual, with appropriate first aid cover and equipment present
* Develop, maintain and update the Site Emergency Plan.
* Ensuring information is communicated effectively around the site.
* Planning for effective signage in line with corporate branding
* Efficient management of any special public access roads – access to show houses/sales pavilions etc.
* Provision of an effective security management system that ensures all the above is achievable.


**Change Management**
* Variations and adjustments to Logistics Contractors scope, review the requirements and assess the impacts. Monitor construction change management process via the Engineer.


**Permitting**
* The Logistics Contractor's'acquisition of all necessary permits for smooth logistics operations.


**Cost**
* Review completeness of established budgets and review cost plans. Ensure that work is re\-measured and work is signed off in accordance with the contract.


**Planning**
* The monthly detailed graphical time slice showing plot and infrastructure activities and how logistics will support. Review weekly plans, confirm the activities are accurate and coordinated across stakeholders.


**Risk**
* Review detailed risk register developed by logistics contractor and team coordinated with all site stakeholders, complete with implement mitigation plan.


**Interface**
* Provide coordination across all programme consultants and stakeholders related to logistics works. Provide support to plots in terms of external access and influences that impact plot activities.


**Communication**
* Through regular meetings, highlight issues, concerns and roll out weekly directions to stakeholder's team managers. Seek resolution to any issues with the respective plot, infrastructure or logistics teams or escalate with the proposed mitigation plan.


**Reporting**
* Weekly issues through detailed logistics dashboards.


**Assurance**
* Submission of checklists of all logistics contractor self\-audits (QA, Safety, Environmental, Welfare etc.) review and report on status.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management or Real Estate Development
* Chartership preferred
* CSCS, SMSTS/SSSTS, Recognised safety programme (qualified and up to date), First Aid, Lifting Supervisor Certification, Traffic management, Institutional membership


**About You**
* More than 20 years as a strategic and operations executive in a range of dynamic start\-up, growth and stable corporate environments. Management of complex, matrixed team environments across multiple cultures.
* Prior KSA projects experience is mandatory
* Global experience with the cycle of new business creation, investment analysis, portfolio creation and management and industrialised processing.
* Line management P\&L'experience including cashflow forecasting and management, financial reporting, review and structure of complex financial transactions.
* Fluent in English (read, write and speak).


 Rewards \& benefits
   

  

 Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Tax\-free salary.
* Life insurance coverage.
* Medical insurance.
* Annual leave balance.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Annual flight contribution.
* Transportation \& housing allowances.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.


 Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
   

  

**About AtkinsRéalis**
 We're AtkinsRéalis, a world\-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
   

  

 Find out more.

data.jd_text:
**Position Overview**
 Product Engineering Head Job Description
   

  

 We are seeking a Product Engineering Head to lead the engineering organization responsible for building, scaling, and evolving our core products. This role represents the senior engineering leader who translates product vision into technical reality, working in close partnership with the Product Management team to deliver innovative Decision Intelligence solutions to market.
   

  

 You will own the complete engineering delivery of our product roadmap — from architecture and technical design through implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement. Leading a cross\-functional engineering organization (backend, frontend, data/ML, DevOps, QA), you will build world\-class product engineering capabilities that enable rapid innovation, exceptional user experiences, and enterprise\-grade reliability at scale. Your focus is building standardized, multi\-tenant and AI agents that serve many customers, as opposed to one\-off customized solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Product\-Engineering Partnership \& Strategy
   

  

* Partner closely with the Product Management team as the senior engineering leader to translate product vision, strategy, and roadmap into executable engineering plans and deliverables.
* Participate in product strategy discussions, roadmap planning sessions, and product prioritization decisions providing technical perspective on feasibility, effort, trade\-offs, and innovation opportunities.
* Collaborate with Product Management to define product requirements, acceptance criteria, and success metrics ensuring shared understanding between product vision and engineering execution.
* Provide technical input and engineering perspective during product discovery, user research synthesis, and feature conceptualization helping shape product decisions with engineering insights on what's possible, scalable, and innovative.
* Balance product ambition with engineering pragmatism identifying opportunities to deliver breakthrough user value while managing technical complexity, debt, and platform stability.
* Champion engineering excellence and platform thinking in product discussions ensuring product decisions consider long\-term architectural health, technical debt management, scalability requirements, and engineering sustainability.


 Platform Architecture \& Technical Leadership
   

  

* Own the technical architecture and platform strategy for all products and AI agents ensuring scalable, secure, maintainable, and performant multi\-tenant systems.
* Define and drive the evolution of core platform capabilities, shared services, component libraries, design systems, and engineering infrastructure that accelerate product development velocity.
* Make critical architectural decisions on technology choices, system design patterns, data architecture, API contracts, integration strategies, and infrastructure approaches balancing innovation, proven technologies, and team capabilities.
* Establish and maintain engineering standards, architectural principles, design patterns, security guidelines, and quality benchmarks that ensure consistency and excellence across the product engineering organization.
* Drive technical innovation in AI/ML model deployment, real\-time data processing, intelligent automation, and Decision Intelligence capabilities that differentiate our products in the market.
* Lead architectural reviews, technology evaluations, and technical risk assessments providing oversight and guidance on major technical decisions across product engineering teams.
* Proactively manage technical debt balancing the need to move fast on product roadmap with maintaining high code quality, system reliability, and long\-term platform health.


 Engineering Delivery \& Execution Excellence
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end engineering delivery of product roadmap translating product requirements into technical specifications, breaking down complex features, and driving execution across engineering teams.
* Establish and continuously improve engineering processes, development workflows, sprint ceremonies, code review practices, testing strategies, and deployment pipelines that maximize team velocity and product quality.
* Drive predictable, high\-velocity product delivery ensuring engineering teams consistently ship high\-quality features on schedule that meet product requirements and delight users.
* Monitor and optimize engineering velocity, deployment frequency, lead time, mean time to recovery (MTTR), and other key engineering performance metrics identifying bottlenecks and driving continuous improvement.
* Coordinate closely with Data Science/ML teams to integrate AI models, intelligent features, and decision support capabilities into products ensuring seamless collaboration between research and production engineering.
* Establish robust quality assurance practices including automated testing (unit, integration, end\-to\-end), performance testing, security testing, and user acceptance testing that ensure product excellence.
* Drive DevOps excellence and production reliability ensuring systems achieve enterprise\-grade uptime, performance, scalability, security, and observability through robust SRE practices.
* Lead incident response, post\-mortem analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives — building a culture of operational excellence, learning from failures, and proactively preventing issues.


 Organization Leadership \& Team Development
   

  

* Build, lead, and scale a world\-class product engineering organization across multiple disciplines: backend engineering, frontend/UI engineering, data/ML engineering, DevOps/SRE, and quality engineering.
* Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional engineering talent establishing the company as a destination for top engineers seeking challenging product problems, cutting\-edge technology, and career growth.
* Develop engineering leaders within the organization mentoring engineering managers, tech leads, and senior engineers to grow their technical, leadership, and product thinking capabilities.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and customer obsession throughout the product engineering organization.
* Establish clear engineering career progression frameworks, competency expectations, performance standards, and growth pathways that enable engineers to advance their careers.
* Drive organizational effectiveness through appropriate team structures, clear ownership models, effective communication practices, and efficient decision\-making processes.
* Ensure high team engagement, satisfaction, and retention through regular 1\-on\-1s, team feedback sessions, recognition programs, growth opportunities, and addressing concerns proactively.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Collaborate effectively with Product Design team to ensure engineering feasibility, implementation quality, and technical innovation support excellent user experiences and design vision.

**Requirements**
 Education

**Experience**

 Technical Expertise
